sa: अर्जुनश्च यथा संख्ये भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च रणे चक्रुः पराक्रमम्॥
en: As also the prowess that Arjuna and Bhimasena the son of Pandu, and Nakula and Sahadeva did display in battle;

sa: न्यवेदयत चात्मानमर्जुनस्य महात्मनः। इरावानस्मि भद्रं ते पुत्रश्चाहं तव प्रभो॥
en: He introduced himself to the illustrious Arjuna saying-'I am your son Iravat, O lord, may good betide you.'

sa: संजय उवाच हन्त ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि विमर्दमतिदारुणम्। एकस्य च बहूनां च यथाऽऽसीत्तुमुलो रणः॥
en: Sanjaya said Yes; I will tell you all about the dreadful carnage, the dreadful battle that was fought between the one and the many.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा दुपदो यज्ञसेनः सर्वं तत्त्वं मन्त्रविद्भयो निवेद्या मन्त्रं राजा मन्त्रयामास राजन् यथायुक्तं रक्षणे वै प्रजानाम्॥
en: Hearing this, king Drupada known as Yagasena, having conformed all his councillors of all these facts, held a consultation, O king, as to the best means of protecting his subjects.

sa: ऊर्ध्वमधश्च तिर्यक् च लोकानावृत्य तिष्ठति। तस्य पार्श्वेष्वमी द्वीपाश्चत्वारः संस्थिता विभो॥
en: It stands carrying the worlds above, below and transversely. O lord, by the side of Meru are situated four islands.

sa: तस्मात् कामं ममायेमं राम सम्पादयानघ। जहि भीष्मं महाबाहो यथा वृत्रं पुरंदरः॥
en: Therefore do you fulfill this desire of mine, O sinless Rama; slay Bhishma, O you of long arms, as Purandara slew Vritra.

sa: एकस्थाः सर्ववर्णास्ते मण्डलं बहुयोजनम्। पर्याक्रामन्त देशांश्च नदी: शैलान् वनानि च।॥
en: Men of all races assembled there, and they occupied an area extending many Yojanas over fields, rivers, hills and woods.

sa: जघानात्र पिता पुत्रं पुत्रश्च पितरं तथा। इत्यासीत् तुमुलं युद्धं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: In that battle, father slew his son and son slew his father, thus raged the fierce fight in which nothing could be distinguished. a

sa: कलिङ्गैः सह चेदीनां निषादैश्च विशाम्पते। कृत्वा पुरुषकारं तु यथाशक्ति महाबलाः॥
en: Between the Chedis and the Kalingas with the Nishadas, Displaying their prowess to the best of their power, the powerful.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां क्रोधेन द्विगुणीकृतः। चिच्छेद सायकांस्तेषां ध्वजांश्चैव धनूंषि च॥
en: Thereafter regaining consciousness, and swelling through fury to double his dimensions, cut the bows, arrows and standards of his adversaries.

sa: संजय उवाच रथस्थं पुरुषव्याघ्रं दृष्ट्वा कर्णमवस्थितम्। हृष्टो दुर्योधनो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, seeing that foremost of men Karna scated on his car, Duryodhana highly enraptured, spoke these words.

sa: ऋषयः पितरश्चैव प्रशशंसुर्महाव्रतम्।१२०॥ भरतानां च ये पूर्वे ते चैनं प्रशशंसिरे।
en: The sages and the Patriarchs all applauded Bhishma. The ancestral manes of the Bharata race also began to praise him.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् पुरस्कृत्य धनंजयम्। भीष्ममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त जये कृत्वा दृढां मतिम्॥
en: So also, O monarch, the Pandavas firmly setting their heart upon victory rushed at Bhishma, placing Dhananjaya at their head.

sa: प्रत्युत्थाय च गोविन्दं स तस्मा आसनं ददौ। न चासने स्वयं बुद्धिं बीभत्सुर्व्यदधात् तदा॥
en: Standing up therefore (in his dream), he welcomed Govinda and offered him a seat, He himself however then did not think of resuming his own seat.

sa: सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ भरतानां पितामहः॥ धुष्टद्युम्नं च विंशत्या कैकेयं चापि पञ्चभिः।
en: The (Kuru) grandfather, struck Satyaki in that great battle with one hundred arrows, Dhrishtadyumna with twenty and the Kaikeya brothers with five.

sa: अनुगास्तस्य वित्रस्ताः प्राद्रवन् सर्वतो दिशः॥ आर्जुनेः कर्म तद् दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रणेदुः समन्ततः । नादेन सर्वभूतानि साधु साध्विति भारत॥
en: His followers then seized with panic, fled in : all directions. Beholding that fcat achieved by Arjuna's son, all creatures were filled with i delight and they applauded him, O Bharata, saying, “Well-done" Well-done".

sa: सारङ्गाश्वो युधामन्युः स्वयं प्रत्वरयन् हयान्। पर्यवर्तत दुर्धर्षः क्रुद्धो द्रोणरथं प्रति॥
en: Inflamed with ire, the invincible Yudhamanyu proceeded towards the car of Drona, being borne by excellent steeds of variegated hue.

sa: इत्यासीत् तुमुलः शब्दो दुर्धर्षस्य रथं प्रति। ततो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णो द्रौणी राजा जयद्रथः॥
en: Thereupon Drona, Kripa, Karna, Drona's son, king Jayadratha, the two princes from Avanti, viz., Vinda and Anuvinda and Shalya, checked that assault (of the Pandava troops).

sa: सम्प्रेक्ष्य तं महाबाहुं रुक्मपुङ्खः समावृतम्। त्वदीयाः प्रपलायन्ते मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव॥
en: Beholding that mighty-armed hero Shalya, covered with gold-winged shafts, your troops fled like herds of deer frightened by the lion.

sa: मा विषादे मनः पार्थ कृथाः कालो हि दुर्जयः। कालः सर्वाणि भूतानि नियच्छति परे विधौ॥
en: O Son of Pritha, let not your heart give way to sorrow. Time is invincible. It is time that compels all creatures to take to the inevitable course.

sa: कर्णस्तं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। अश्वत्थामा च विंशत्या कृतवर्मा च सप्तभिः॥
en: Thereafter Karna pierced him in return, with twenty-five long shafts. Ashvatthaman pierced him with twenty and Kritavarman with seven arrows.

sa: शृणु राजन् मम वचो यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि कौरव। यथा त्वया महाराज वर्तितव्यं परंतप॥
en: "Hear, O king the words that I shall speak to you, O scion of the Kuru race, about how you should conduct yourself, Ogrinder of foes.

sa: तथा तु वर्तमाने वै संग्रामेऽतिभयंकरे॥ दुर्योधनो महाराज राधेयमिदमब्रवीत्।
en: Thus, O king, when the awful battle raged furiously, Duryodhana addressing Radha's son said these words-

sa: प्रासैर्यन्त्रैविंचित्रैश्च शस्त्रैश्च विमलैस्तथा॥ स चक्रे वसुधां कीर्णां शबलैः कुसुमैरिव। आप्लुत्य रथिनः कांश्चित् परामृश्य महाबलः॥ पातयामास खड्ड्रेन सध्वजानपि पाण्डवः।
en: He caused the earth to be covered with blood, thus making her look as if she were variegated with lilies. The might Pandava, jumping high and dragging down some carwarriors, cut them down with their standards.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं रणे द्रोणः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। छादयामास राजेन्द्र नचिरादेव भारत॥
en: Within a short while straight jointed shafts, covered Arjuna in that battle, O foremost of kings, O Bharata.

sa: तस्य तत् कुर्वतः कर्म महत् संख्ये महीभृतः। पूजयांचक्रिरे हृष्टाः प्रशशंसुश्च फाल्गुनिम्॥
en: When he was achieving these wonderful feats in battle, the rulers of earth greatly delighted worshipped and applauded the son of Phalguna.

sa: ये तु पुष्करपर्णस्य तुल्यवर्णा हयोत्तमाः। ते रोचमानस्य सुतं हेमवर्णमुदावहन्॥
en: Excellent steeds that resembled in colour the hue of the Puskara flower, bore Hemavarna the son of Rochamana.

sa: सप्तैते परमक्रुद्धाः किरीटिनमभिद्रुताः। तत्र शस्त्राणि दिव्यानि दर्शयन्तो महारथाः॥
en: These seven car-warriors waxing irascible and displaying weapons of celestial make rushed against the diadem-decked Arjuna.

sa: सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ विराटदुपदौ चोभौ राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः।
en: arose Then Satyaki, Bhimasena, Prishata's son Dhrishtadyumna, both Virata and Draupada, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha,

sa: यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्। तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय॥
en: As the great and ubiquitous atmosphere (without tainting) live, occupying space, so similarly all things live in Me.

sa: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय रामः क्रोधसमन्वितः। हेमपुङ्कान् सुनिशिताशरांस्तान् हि ववर्ष सः॥
en: Then did Rama, wrathfully taking up another bow, shoot forth arrows well sharpened and furnished with golden wings.

sa: नागं जिघांसुः सहसा चिक्षेप च महाबलः। स विस्फुलिङ्गमालाभिः समन्तात् परिवेष्टितः॥
en: Then that highly powerful hero desirous of slaying the elephant, hurled the lance, emitting scintillations of fire from all sides.

sa: तत्र स्वयंप्रभा देवी नित्यं वसति शाण्डिली। उत्तरेण तु शृङ्गस्य समुद्रान्ते जनाधिप॥
en: There always dwells the self luminous lady named Shandili. On the north of Shringavat and as far as the sea, O king,

sa: शक्तोऽहं धनुषैकेन निहन्तुं सर्वपाण्डवान्॥ यद्येषां न भवेद् गोप्ता विष्वक्सेनो महाबलः।
en: “I can slay even with a single bow all these Pandavas, if highly powerful Visaksena (Krishna) be not their protector.

sa: बहूनीह सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। स्थानां तव सेनायां यथामुख्यं तु मे शृणु॥
en: There are thousands and tens of thousands and millions of Rathis in your army; listen to me, as I speak of them.

sa: भीष्मः पुरुषमानी च जितकाशी तथैव च। युक्ता भीष्मे कारयितुं तव॥
en: Bhishma is proud of his bravery and success and therefore it stands to reason that your remedy lies in Bhishma.

sa: वसन्ति तेषु सत्त्वानि नानाजातीनि सर्वशः। इदं तु भारतं वर्षं ततो हैमवतं परम्॥
en: In all these kingdoms live creatures of various kinds. This is the Varsha called after Bharata, Next to it the Varsha called after Himavat.

sa: तथैव समरे राजन् पिता देवव्रतस्तव। आससाद रणे पार्थं स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम्॥
en: So also, O monarch your sire Devavrata encountered the son of Pritha in battle, like Rahu meeting the lustrous orb.

sa: रुधिराक्तौ ततस्तौ तु शुशुभाते नरर्षभौ। वसन्तसमये राजन् पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Then those two foremost of men, covered with blood, looked as beautiful as the Kinshuka flowers in spring.

sa: उभयोः सदृशं कर्म स पितुर्मातुलस्य च। रणे बहुविधं चक्रे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: That foremost of all wielders of weapon, performed in battle many a wonderful feat worthy of his father and his maternal uncle.

sa: स तेषां रथिनां वीरः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः। सदृशो वासुदेवस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च॥
en: Thereat that hero (Abhimanyu) equal in prowess to his father and to the son of Vasudeva in strength and powers,

sa: रक्षां कृत्वा ततः शूरा न्यस्य गुल्मान् यथाविधि। अपनीय च शल्यानि स्नात्वा च विविधैर्जलैः॥
en: Then duly arranging for scouts and outposts and for protecting their persons, and drawing out the arrows from their bodies and having bathed in various waters,

sa: स निर्ययौ महाराज पिता देवव्रतस्तव। महता रथवंशेन संवृतो रथिनां वरः॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, your sire Devavrata, that foremost of car-warriors, marched forth surrounded by a mighty host of cars.

sa: ये ते वेदाः शरीरस्था ब्राह्मण्यं यच्च ते महत्। तपश्च महत् तप्तं न तेभ्यः प्रहराम्यहम्॥
en: The Vedas that are in your body and the great spirit of Brahma that is there and the great asceticism practiced by you, I do not strike at.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच वर्षाणां चैव नामानि पर्वतानां च संजय। आचक्ष्व मे यथातत्त्वं ये च पर्वतवासिनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, tell me in detail the names of all the Varshas and of all the mountains and also of all that live on these mountains.

sa: हेमकूटात् परं चैव हरिवर्षं प्रचक्षते। दक्षिणेन तु नीलस्य निषधस्योत्तरेण तु॥
en: The land that is beyond Hemakuta is called Harivarsha; south of the Nila mountain and the north of the Nishadha.

sa: तथा सर्वेण सैन्येन राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। द्रौणेरनन्तरं प्रायात् सोदर्यैः परिवारितः॥
en: After the son of Drona proceeded king Duryodhana accompanied by the whole army and surrounded his uterine brothers.

sa: अथ ते तोमरैः प्रासैर्वाणौधैश्च समन्ततः॥ पट्टिशैश्च सुनिस्त्रिशैर्नाराचैश्च तथा शितैः।
en: Thereupon from all sides, those troops, with dares, lances, arrows, battle-axes, excellent swords, long shafts of great sharpness,

sa: तेनापि विद्धः सहसा द्रौणिर्भल्लैः शितैस्त्रिभिः। धनुर्ध्वजं च छत्रं च द्विषतः स न्यकृन्तत॥
en: Thus pierced deeply by him, Drona's son, with ten whetted and broad-headed arrows, cut-off the bow, the standard and the umbrella of his adversary.

sa: अन्तरिक्षं दिशश्चैव सर्वाश्च प्रदिशस्तथा। तं श्रुत्वा सुमहानादं तव सैन्यस्य भारत॥
en: As also the firmament and all the cardinal and subsidiary quarters. As your soldiers heard, O Bharata, that terrible uproar,

sa: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत् किंचिदस्ति धनंजय। मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।॥
en: There is, O Dhananjaya, nothing higher than Myself. All this is woven on Me like a row of pearls in a string.

sa: समन्वितानि भूतानि तेषु वर्षेषु भारत। एवमेषा महाराज पर्वतैः पृथिवी चिता।॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, in these Varshas, creatures all live together. O king, the earth is thus covered with mountains.

sa: भानुन्मतं ततो भीमः प्राद्रवत् पुरुषर्षभः। भानुमांस्तु ततो भीमं शरवर्षेण च्छादयन्॥ ननाद बलवन्नादं नादयानो नभस्तलम्। न च तं ममृषे भीमः सिंहनादं महाहवे॥
en: That foremost of men, on seeing Bhanumat rushed upon him. Bhanumat thereupon covered Bhima with a shower of arrows. He set up a loud shout making the sky resound with it. Bhima however could not bear that lion-like shout in that battle.

sa: ततो भग्ने बले तस्मिन् विप्रलीने समन्ततः। सव्यसाचिनि संक्रुद्धे त्रैगर्तान् भयमाविशत्॥
en: When that host was shattered and scattered in all directions and when Savyasachin was inflamed with wrath, panic seized Trigarttas.

sa: दुर्योधने च विमुखे राजपुत्रशते हते। सौभद्रे प्रतिपत्ति का प्रत्यपद्यन्त मामकाः॥
en: After Duryodhana had been repulsed and the hundred princes slain, what measure was adopted by my warriors against Subhadra's son.

sa: काञ्चना मणिचित्राङ्गा ज्वलन्त इव पावकाः। अर्चिष्मन्तो व्यरोचन्त गजारोहाः सहस्रशः॥ महेन्द्रकेतवः शुभ्रा महेन्द्रसदनेष्विव। संनद्धास्ते प्रवीराश्च ददृशुर्युद्धकाक्षिणः॥
en: Thousands of bright and beautiful fire-like blazing banners, decked with gold and gems were gazed at by the heroic warriors clad in armour, each one of whom longed for battle.

sa: यक्षा ऊचुः दुपदस्य सुता राजन् राज्ञो जाता शिखण्डिनी। तस्या निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चित् प्रादात् पुरुषलक्षणम्॥
en: The Yakshas said Oking, a daughter was born to king Drupada, by name Shikhandin. For her sake, on some account, he has given away his manhood.

sa: एते वियति कौरव्य दिवि देवगणाः स्थिताः। ते त्वां निवारयन्त्यद्य प्रस्वापं मा प्रयोजयः॥
en: These gods are stationed yonder in the sky, O son of Kuru's race. They are forbidding you today, do not aim the weapon Prasvapa.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां भीमसेनो महाबलः। दुर्योधनं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: Meanwhile Bhimasena of mighty prowess having regained consciousness, pierced Duryodhana with three shafts and again with another five.

sa: ते त्वरध्वं महावीर्याः किं चिरेण प्रयामहे। महान् हि वर्तते रौद्रः संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः॥
en: Therefore, warriors of extraordinary prowess, make havee; O sinless ones, do not delay. This hair stirring and ruthless combat is deepening more and more.

sa: एकैकेन हि बाणेन भूमौ पातितवानहम्। हयांस्तेषां गजांश्चैव सारथींचाप्यहं रणे॥
en: By one arrow did I lay each to the ground with their horses, elephants, and drivers in battle.

sa: कृष्ण पश्य महात्मानं भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम्। गजं नलवनानीव विमृद्रन्त बलं मम॥
en: Behold, O Krishna, the high-souled Bhishma of fierce prowess crush my ariny like an elephant crushing a forest of reeds.

sa: तत्र गच्छाम भद्रं वो राजानं परिरक्षितुम्। अरक्ष्यमाणः समरे क्षिप्रं प्राणान् विमोक्ष्यति॥
en: Good betide you, we shall now proceed to protect the king; unprotected, in battle, he will soon be deprived of his life.

sa: हयारोहैर्हयारोहाः पात्यन्ते स्म महाहवे। ऋष्टिभिविमलाभिश्च प्रासैरपि च संयुगे॥
en: In that fearful battle, horse-men cut down horsemen with sharp and polished swords and long lances.

sa: ततोऽवहारं सैन्यानां चक्रे राजा युधिष्ठिरः। तथैव तव सैन्यानामवहारो ह्यभूत् तदा॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira withdrew his troops; so also the withdrawal of your forces was also done at the same time.

sa: मघास्वङ्गारको वक्रः श्रवणे च बृहस्पतिः। भगं नक्षत्रमाक्रम्य सूर्यपुत्रेण पीड्यते॥
en: Mars advances towards Magha and Brihaspati towards Shravana. the sun's offspring (Shani) advances towards Phalguni and afflicts it.

sa: तस्य चान्येऽपि दिङ्नागा बभूवुरनुयायिनः। अञ्जनो वामनश्चैव महापद्मश्च सुप्रभः॥
en: Other elephants guarding the points of the compass, namely, Anjana, Vamana Mahapadma, followed it, all effulgence.

sa: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत् तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम॥
en: Know me, O Bharata. as Kshetrajna in all Kshetras. I consider the knowledge of Kshetra and Kshetrajna to be the true knowledge.

sa: एष भीष्मः सुसंक्रुद्धो वार्ष्णेय मम वाहिनीम्। नाशयिष्यति सुव्यक्तं दुर्योधनहिते रतः॥
en: O descendant of Vrishni, it is apparent that Bhishma, in anger, will annihilate our troops for the good of Duryodhana.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा कर्णदुःशासनादिभिः। सम्मत्र्योवाच दुर्धर्षमाचार्य जयतां चार्यं जयतां वरम्॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana, accompanied by Karna, Dushasana and others thus spoke to the invincible preceptor, the foremost of all victors.

sa: यथा लक्ष्म स्थिरं चन्द्रे समुद्रे च यथा जलम्। एवमेतां प्रतिज्ञां मे सत्यां विद्धि जनार्दन॥
en: As Lakshmi is ever constant in the moon, as water ever remains in the ocean, so, O Janardana, know my vow to be ever incapable of being frustrated.

sa: अति सर्वाणि भूतानि रामो दाशरथिर्बभौ। ऋषीणां देवतानां च मानुषाणां च सर्वशः॥
en: Indeed Rama, the of Dasaratha surpassed in beauty all other created beings. The Rishis, the celestials and the mortals all together. son

sa: बहूनि च सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। कोट्यश्च लोकवीराणां समेताः कुरुजाङ्गले॥
en: Many thousands, many millions, many tens of millions, many hundreds of millions of warriors have assembled at Kurukshetra.

sa: अन्योन्यं रथिन: पेतुर्वाजिनश्च महाहवे। कुञ्जरान् कुञ्जरा जनुः पादातांश्च पदातयः॥
en: In that dreadful battle car-warriors and horsemen, smote down one another Elephants crushed elephants, and foot-soldiers slew footsoldiers.

sa: ततो निशि च राजेन्द्र प्रसुप्तः शरविक्षतः। दक्षिणेनेह पार्श्वन प्रभातसमये तदा।॥
en: Then, O great king, mangled with arrows, as I lay asleep that night on my right, at about dawn came,

sa: शस्त्रं ग्राहं रणे जह्यां श्रुत्वा महदप्रियम्। श्रद्धेयवाक्यात् पुरुषादेतत् सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I tell you also that having heard something very disagreeable from some creditable source, I will abandon my arms in the battle.

sa: श्रुतागुषं च राजानं धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। चेकितानश्च समरे कृपमेवान्वयोधयत्॥
en: Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, engaged king Shrutayush; and in that battle Chekitana fought with Kripa.

sa: महेन्द्रसदृशः शौर्ये स्थैर्ये च हिमवानिव। समुद्र इव गाम्भीर्ये सहिष्णुत्वे धरासमः॥
en: Resembling the great Indra in bravery, the carth herself in patience, the Himalayas in firinness, and the ocean in gravity.

sa: अश्वत्थामा तु समरे सात्यकि नवभिः शरैः। त्रिंशता च पुनस्तूर्णं बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon Ashvathama pierced Satyaki in that battle, first with nine shafts, and next with thirty more on the breast and the arms.

sa: तस्य दारक्रियां तात चिकीर्षुरहमप्युत। अनुरूपादिव कुलादित्येव च मनो दधे॥
en: I, too being desirous of getting his wives, set my heart on procuring suitable girls from good families.

sa: यो यः स्म समरे पार्थे प्रतिसंचरते नरः। तस्य तस्यान्तको बाणः शरीरमुपसर्पति॥
en: Whoever then ventured to advance in rage against Partha, had a fatal shafts discharged by that hero, stuck deep on his body.

sa: तेषां राजसहस्राणां हयानां दन्तिनां तथा। द्वाभ्यां त्रिभिः शरैश्चान्यान् पार्थो विव्याध मारिष॥
en: Among those thousands of kings, steeds and tuskers. The rest, O sire, the son Pritha pierced, each with two or three shafts.

sa: मागधाश्च कलिङ्गाश्च दासेरकगणैः सह। दक्षिणं पक्षमासाद्य स्थिता व्यूहस्य दंशिताः॥
en: The Magadhas the Kalingas with all the Daserakas clad in armour, formed the right wing of that Vyuha.

sa: तेन संचोद्यमानस्तु याहि याहीति सारथिः। प्रत्युवाच ततो राजन्नभिमन्युमिदं वचः॥
en: Thus commanded by him with the words "Proceed, proceed", the charioteer, o king, then replied to Abhimanyu saying-

sa: संजय उवाच तथा प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे निवृत्ते च सुशर्मणि। भग्नेषु चापि वीरेषु पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥
en: Sanjaya said When the battle thus raged, when Susharma had turned away from the battle when the highsouled son of Pandu (Arjuna) had broken your ranks,

sa: युगपच्चैव संग्रामे शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। पतिता एव मे दृष्टाः संशप्तकमहारथाः॥
en: I have seen today slay simultaneously in battle, hundreds and thousands of mighty carwarriors of the Samshaptaka host.'

sa: वैशम्पयान उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौरव्यो राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। मुहूर्तमिव स ध्यात्वा भीष्मे युक्तममन्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said On hearing this, king Duryodhana, a descendant of Kuru's race, having reflected for a moment, considered this to be fitting in Bhishma.

sa: बाहुभिः कार्मुकैः खङ्गैः शिरोभिश्च सकुण्डलैः। तलत्रैरङ्गुलित्रैश्च ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः॥
en: With arms, bows, words, and heads graced with ear-rings, with finger-protectors and gloves, and broken standards,

sa: निवर्तस्व महीपाल नैतज्जात्वन्यथा भवेत्। स तु गत्वा न नगरं भार्यामिदमुवाच ह॥
en: Desist therefore, O protector of the earth, it shall never be otherwise." He (king Drupada) entering his city said to his wife.

sa: स च वीरान् रणे हत्वा राजपुत्रान् महाबलान्। वीरैराकाइक्षितं मृत्युं सम्प्रापतोऽभिमुखं रणे॥
en: That they may fall in battle facing their enemies. As regards Abhimanyu, he, having slain in battle many heroic and mighty princes.

sa: क्षुभ्यमाणे बले तूर्णं सागरप्रतिमे तव। प्रत्युद्याते च गाङ्गेये त्वरितं विजयं प्रति॥
en: When your army resembling the mighty main had been greatly agitated, and when the son of Ganga had swiftly advanced towards Vijaya,

sa: युगपच्चैव संग्रामे शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। पतिता एव मे दृष्टाः संशप्तकमहारथाः॥
en: I have seen today slay simultaneously in battle, hundreds and thousands of mighty carwarriors of the Samshaptaka host.'

sa: अरण्यवासिनः सप्त सप्तैषां ग्रामवासिनः। सिंहा व्याघ्रा वराहाच महिषा वारणास्तथा॥
en: Seven are wild and seven domestic. O king, lions, tigers, boars, buffaloes, elephants, bears, and monkeys are wild.

sa: य इमां वसुसम्पूर्णो वसुधां वसुधाधिपः। ईजानो वितते यज्ञे ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ह्यमन्यत॥
en: That king of the earth, celebrating various sacrifices, offered this earth replete with treasures, to the Brahmanas as a gift.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणौ हतौ श्रुत्वा किं नु जीवामि संजय। यां तां श्रियमसूयामः पुरा दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: Namely, Bhishma and Drona, hearing of their death, why do I, O Sanjaya, still live? That prosperity, seeing which attend Yudhishthira before, we were so jealous.

sa: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते। इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः॥
en: The truly wise man, endued with My nature, worship Me, believing that I am the origin of all, and from Me all things proceed.

sa: तेषु विद्रवमाणेषु तव योधेषु सर्वशः। अर्जुनो वासुदेवश्च दध्मतुर्वारिजोत्तमौ॥
en: When all your troops broke down and fled away, Arjuna and Vasudeva blew their excellent conchs.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तो महाबाहुः केशवः सव्यसाचिना। अचोदयद्धयांस्तत्र यत्र दुर्मर्षणः स्थितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to by Savyasachin, the mighty-armed Keshava drove the steeds to the spot where Durmarsana was standing.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सूर्योदये संजय के नु पूर्व युयुत्सवो हृष्यमाणा इवासन्। मामका वा भीष्मनेत्रा: समीपे पाण्डवा वा भीमनेत्रास्तदानीम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, when the sun rose, of the two armies, one commanded by Bhishma and the other by Bhima, which first cheerfully met the other, desirous as they were both to fight?

sa: सर्वेष्वपि च लोकेषु बीभत्सुरपराजितः। प्राधान्येनैव भूयिष्ठममेयाः केशवे गुणा:॥
en: In all the regions, Vibhatsu is unconquerable. All virtues are in Keshava in an extraordinary degree.

sa: स यदा तात संनोत् पाण्डवार्थाय संजय। न तदा प्रतिसंयोद्धा भविता तत्र कश्चन॥
en: When that one, O son, O Sanjaya, clothes himself in mail for the interests of the Pandavas, none will come forth as his antagonist.

sa: श्वसन्निवान्तरिक्षे च जलबिन्दुभिरुक्षितः। ते मां समन्तात् ततस्ते ब्राह्मणा राजन्नब्रुवन् परिगृह्य माम्॥
en: They sprinkled drops of water on me as I was breathing heavily and then those Brahmanas, bearing me up, said to me.

sa: संजय उवाच श्रुत्वा तु तं महाशब्दं पाण्डूनां जयगृद्धिनाम्। चारैः प्रवेदिते तत्र समुत्थाय जयद्रथः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having heard the loud uproar created by the Pandavas desirous of victory and having ascertained through spies the cause thereof, Jayadratha then rose up.

sa: विसृष्टं भगदत्तेन तदस्त्रं सर्वघाति वै। उरसा प्रतिजग्राह पार्थं संच्छाद्य केशवः॥
en: Thereupon Keshava, covering Pritha's son, received upon his own breast that weapon capable of slaying every being, hurled by Bhagadatta.

sa: गच्छतां वो नदीतीरं सहितानां विशेषतः। पृष्ठतोऽहं गमिष्यामि सहैव मातुलेन तु॥
en: You go to the river side together in advance); after you, I shall go in company with our maternal uncle.

sa: अत्यद्भुतमहं मन्ये बलं शौर्यं च सैन्धवे। तस्य प्रब्रूहि मे वीर्ये कर्म चाय्यं महात्मनः॥
en: It appears to me that the Sindhu ruler was endowed with wonderful might and heroism. Tell me of the feats and heroism of that illustrious warrior.

sa: सृञ्जयस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तव चैव शुचिस्मिते। यदत्र ते भृशं कार्यं तदद्यैव विचिन्त्यताम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Srinjaya, and of yours, O you of beautiful smiles, let what ought to be done this very day be settled.

sa: आचार्य केन कालेन पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकान्। निहन्या इति तं द्रोणः प्रत्युवाच हसन्निव॥
en: “O preceptor, in what time can you annihilate the soldiers of the son of Pandu?” Drona replied to him, as if smilingly.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्यां निशायां व्युष्टायं द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। स्वान्यनीकानि सर्वाणि प्राक्रामद् व्यूहितुं ततः॥
en: Sanjaya said After the night had passed away, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, viz., Drona began to dispose of his divisions in battle array.

sa: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर। असक्तो ह्याचरन् कर्म परमाप्नोति पुरुषः॥
en: Therefore, being freed from all attachments, perform actions. For, the man who performs actions without attachment, attain to the Supreme.

sa: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः। एतत् क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, body consciousness, courage, all these five have been declared to be Kshetra in its modified form.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे स्थितः। अर्जुनं पञ्चविंशत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then he took another shaft and stood before Bhishma. He pierced twentyfive shafts on the chaste of Arjuna

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा शूराणां हयसादिनाम्। अयुतं प्रेषयामास पाण्डवानां निवारणे॥११॥
en: Then king Duryodhana dispatched a detachment of ten thousand horses all brave warriors, for checking the Pandavas. a

sa: ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः। श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः॥
en: Those men who without cavil always follow my this opinion, being full of faith, are released from Karmabandhanam.

sa: के नु पश्चादवर्तन्त गच्छन्तो दुर्गमां गतिम्। केऽरक्षन् दक्षिणं चक्रं सव्यं के च महात्मनः॥ पुरस्तात् के च वीरस्य
en: Who were they who brought up his rear and obtained that end which is so difficult to being attained? Who were they that covered the right। and the left wings of that high-souled one?

sa: बाह्रीकं च त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। कृपमेकेन विव्याध चित्रसेनं त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: He pierced Balhika with three shafts, betwecn his breasts; then he pierced Kripa with one shaft and Mitrasena with three.

sa: पीडितश्चैव पुत्रस्ते पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥ हित्वा पार्थं रणे तूर्णं भीष्मस्य रथमाव्रजत्।
en: Thus your son sorely afflicted by the illustrious son of Pandu, quickly avoiding him proceeded towards the chariot of Bhishma.

sa: दुर्योधनो महाराज दुःशासनमभाषत। एष शूरो महेष्वासो भीष्मः शूरनिषूदनः॥
en: Duryodhana, O monarch, said to Dushasana "This heroic Bhishma, this mighty bowman and slayer of heroes,

sa: तं सात्यकिर्भीमसेनो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। अभ्यद्रवन्त भीष्मस्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Thereupon Satyaki, Bhima, and the Prishata prince Dhrishtadyumna all rushed towards Bhishma's car decked with gold.

sa: श्वेतः कुरूणामकरोत् क्षयं तस्मिन् महाहवे॥ राजपुत्रान् रथोदारानधीच्छतसंघशः।
en: In that fearful battle Shveta killed innumerable Kurus. He killed hundreds of noble princes.

sa: तथा परिवृतं दृष्ट्वा वार्ष्णेयानां महारथम्। दुर्योधनो भृशं क्रुद्धो भ्रातॄन् सर्वानुवाच ह॥
en: Then seeing that mighty car-warrior of the Vrishni race thus surrounded, king Duryodhana highly excited with rage, thus spoke to his brothers.

sa: माधवस्तु सुसंक्रुद्धो राक्षसं नवभिः शरैः। आजघान रणे राजन् प्रहसन्निव भारत॥
en: Thereupon, O king, he of Madhu's race, wrought up with rage, wounded the Rakshasa with nine shafts, as if smiling.

sa: एते हि बहवः शूराः कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः। यथा हन्युर्न नः सेनां तथा माधव चोदया।४६।।
en: O Madhava, so guide the steeds that these numerous heroes irrepressible in battle and all accomplished in the use of weapons, may not slay our troops.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः प्रभाते राजेन्द्र सूर्ये विमलतां गते। भार्गवस्य मया सार्धं पुनयुद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Bhishma said In the morning when the sun had risen, there again began the fight between myself and the scion of the Bhrigu's race.

sa: दिष्टमेव परं मन्ये पौरुषादिति मे मतिः। यत्र शान्तनवो भीष्मो नातरद् युधि पाण्डवम्॥
en: When Shantanu's son, Bhishma, could not escape the son of Pandu (Arjuna) in battle, O Sanjaya, I consider Destiny to be supreme over exertion.

sa: मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्हम्। सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत॥
en: The Great Brahma is the womb in which I place the germ. Thence, O Bharata, take place the births of all beings.

sa: सत्यव्रतः पुरुमित्रो जयो भूरिश्रवाः शलः॥ रथा विंशतिसाहस्रास्तथैषामनुयायिनः।
en: Amongst them were Satyavrata, Purumitra, Jaya, Bhurishrava and Sala, Twenty thousand car-warriors followed them.

sa: सारथिं चास्य विव्याध त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी। पीड्यमानस्ततो राजा द्रुपदो वाहिनीमुखे॥
en: Thereupon king Drupada thus afflicted before the army, fled, borne away by fleet steeds, remembering his former enmity.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् स्थिरो भूत्वा युद्धमेतत् सुदारुणम्। न शक्याः पाण्डवा जेतुं देवैरपि सवासवैः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, hear about this fearful battle. The son of Pandu (Arjuna) is incapable of being vanquished by even the celestials with Indra at their head.

sa: धरणी विविशुः सर्वे वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः। हयांश्चास्य ततो जघ्ने सारथिं च न्यपातयत्॥
en: Penetrated the earth like so many snakes entering their holes in ant-bills. Then Arjuna slew the steeds and charioteer of the latter.

sa: शोचिष्यसे महाराज सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवः। इमं च क्लेशमस्माकं हृष्टो यत् त्वं विकत्थसे॥
en: You will grieve, ogreat king, along with your sons, kinsmen and friends, for this brag of yours at our troubles."

sa: हेमकूटात् परं चैव हरिवर्षं प्रचक्षते। अन्योन्यं नाभिवर्तन्ते साम्यं भवति वै यदा॥
en: On which depend all creatures in the universe for their existence. They do not depend on each other when there is equipoise.

sa: तावकानां तु योधानां वध्यतां निशितैः शरैः। अन्यत्र सैन्धवाद् राजन् न स्म कश्चिदतिष्ठत॥
en: Amongst all your warriors then thus slaughtered by Abhimanyu with his sharp shafts, none stayed on the field, except the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: तत्र वृद्धतमः कश्चित् कोलिको नाम मूषिकः। अब्रवीद् वचनं राजन् ज्ञातिमध्ये यथातथम्॥ न मातुलो धर्मकामश्छद्ममात्रं कृता शिखा।
en: Said this words, O king, among the members of his race which was indeed the truth. The desire of our maternal uncle is not to carn virtue, it is only a disguise.

sa: न कृपो न च गान्धारी नाहं संजय रोचये। न वासुदेवो वार्ष्णेयो धर्मराजश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: Nor did Kripa, nor Gandhari, nor did I, O Sanjaya, like it. Nor did the Vrishni chief, Vasudeva (Krishna), nor that son of Pandu, Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: अज्ञातमाने च धनंजयेऽपि महाहवे सम्प्रसक्ते नृवीरे। कथं हि भीष्मात् प्रथितः पृथिव्यां भयं त्वमद्य प्रकरोषि वीर॥
en: But, behold, O hero Dhananjaya has engaged in dreadful fight with Bhishma even without your knowledge. Celebrated through out the world, why today, O hero are you afraid to Bhishma?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा तु संजयं कर्णे कीर्तयन्तं पुनः पुनः। आशीविषवदुच्छ्वस्य धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon breathing (heavily) out like a snake, Dhritarashtra spoke these words to Sanjaya who had been thus repeatedly extolling Karna.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे भीमसेनपुरोगमाः। भीष्मेण युद्धमिच्छन्तः प्रययुर्हष्टमानसाः॥
en: Desiring to fight with Bhishma, the Pandavas cheerfully advanced with Bhimasena at their head.

sa: अवश्यं च मया कार्य पूर्वेषां चरितं महत्। कर्ता चाहं तथा कर्म यथा नान्यः करिष्यति॥
en: The work of which I shall be the doer no one else will do.” Then did the virtuous king say the noble words out of kindness to him.

sa: समुत्सार्य ततः पश्चाद् धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। भ्रातृभिः सह पुत्रैश्च सोऽभ्यरक्षद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Asking the kings to move onward the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna accompanied by his brothers and sons, protected Yudhishthira from behind.

sa: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने तुमुले संकुले भृशम्। भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तूर्णं युधिष्ठिररमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: When that dreadful and confounding battle was thus raging, Shantanu's son Bhishma quickly rushed against Yudhishthira.

sa: सुशर्मापि ततो बाणैः पार्थं विव्याध संयुगे। वासुदेवं च सप्तत्या पार्थं च नवभिः पुनः॥
en: Thereupon in that battle Susharma pierced Pritha's son with many shafts; he then pierced the son of Vasudeva with seventy shafts and Arjuna again with nine.

sa: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय। उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु॥
en: But, Arjuna, these acts of mine do not fetter me, I sit like one unconcerned and unattached to those actions.

sa: तं शिखण्डी रणे यान्तमभ्यद्रवत दंशितः॥ ततः समाहरद् भीष्मस्तदस्त्रं पावकोपमम्।
en: Then clad in mail Shikhandin confronted him rushing in battle. Whereupon Bhishma withdrew that dare resembling fire itself.

sa: पितामहं ततो दृष्ट्वा श्वेतेन विमुखीकृतम्॥ प्रहर्ष पाण्डवा जग्मुः पुत्रस्ते विमनाऽभवत्।
en: Seeing the grandfather made to retreat by Shveta, the Pandavas grew exceedingly delighted, but your son became very much cheerless.

sa: ततो मां सव्यतो राजन् रामः कुर्वन् द्विजोत्तमः। उरस्यविध्यत् संक्रुद्धो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्॥
en: There did that best among the twice-born, Rama, the son of Jamadagni, suddenly turning to the right, pierce me in my breast.

sa: त्वदीयानां परेषां न रथेषु विपुलान् ध्वजान्। अभिभूयार्जुनस्यैको रथे तस्थौ महाकपिः॥
en: Shadowing all the great standards of the cars on your side, a huge ape stood (as standard) on Arjuna's car.

sa: यदि ते रोचते राजन् वक्ष्यामि शृणु मे वचः। श्रुत्वेदानीं प्रपद्येथाः स्वां मतिं पृषतात्मज॥
en: If it pleases you, O king, hear what I say. And then having listened to it, the descendant of Prishata may take to his own wisdom.

sa: अत्यरोचत तान् सर्वान् धृष्टद्युम्नः समागतान्। सर्वाण्यति च सेन्यानि भारद्वाजो व्यरोचत॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna liked that assembled host very much. But the son of Bharadvaja, excelled the rest of the warriors in splendour.

sa: हताश्वं तु रथं त्यक्त्वा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं नकुलस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Leaving his car the steeds of which were slain, Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, quickly ascended the car of the high-souled Nakula.

sa: यमावपि हि संक्रुद्धः समासाद्य रणे तदा। शरैः संछादयामास भीष्मः परपुरंजयः॥
en: Thereafter 'Bhishma that conqueror of hostile fortresses, excited with wrath, approaching the twins in battle, covered them with numerous shafts.

sa: बहुमित्रा वयं सर्वे तेषां नो मातुलो ह्ययम्। रक्षां करोतु सततं वृद्धबालस्य सर्वशः॥
en: We have many enemies, therefore let this one be our maternal uncle and let him therefore protect always all of us, old and young.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवः प्रादुरासन् सुदारुणाः॥ उत्पाता युधि वीराणां जीवितक्षयकारिणः।
en: These and many other terrible portents appeared indicating a great loss of life of many heroes in the ensuing encounter.

sa: स हि वीरोऽनुरक्तश्च वृद्धः कुरुपतिस्तदा। कृतं वैरं सदा तेन पितुः पुत्रेण धीमता॥ तस्योद्वेगभयाचापि संश्रितः पाण्डवान् पुरा। सर्वं वलं परित्यज्य दुर्ग संश्रित्य तिष्ठति॥
en: The old Kuru chief (Bhishma) is ever cheerful and devoted to us. Though he (Duryodhana) provoked hostilities with that intelligent son of his uncle, (Yudhishthira), yet he once sought the protection of the Pandavas. At that time abandoning every thing, he lived in misery.

sa: तस्य तं निन्दं श्रुत्वा प्रहृष्टोऽभूद् युधिष्ठिरः। कर्ण पराजितं मत्वा भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥
en: Hearing that roar of his, Yudhishthira became filled with delight, as he thought that Karna had been defeated, O Bharata by Bhimasena.

sa: मा त्वं शुचस्तां प्रति भीरु विद्धि यथाद्य कृष्णा पुनरेष्यतीति॥ निहत्य सर्वान् द्विषतः समग्रान् पार्थाः समेष्यन्त्यथा याज्ञसेन्या।
en: Do not weep for her, O timid girl; know that Krishna shall come back even this very day. Having slain all their enemies the sons of Pritha shall be united with Yajnaseni."

sa: संजय उवाच ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो निर्ययौ सह सेनया। व्यूहं चाव्यूहत महत् सर्वतोभद्रमात्मनः॥शा
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter, Bhishma the son of Shantanu advanced with his troops, and he formed his own troops in the array known as Saravatobhadra.

sa: विद्युन्माली रथस्थस्तु शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। सुषेणं ताडयामास ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: And Vidyanmālī, mounted on a car, assailed Suşeņa with shafts decked with gold, and behan to shout momentarily.

sa: तस्मिन्प्लवगशार्दूले विसंज्ञे पतिते भुवि। तच्छूलं समुपादाय सुग्रीवमभिदुद्रुवे॥
en: On that powerful monkey falling down insensible, Kumbhakarma, taking his dart, rushed against Sugriva.

sa: यदा सर्वे विमनसस्ते मल्ला हतचेतसः। अथ सूदेन तं मल्लं योधयामास मत्स्यराट्।॥
en: When all the wrestlers stood stupefied and dejected in spirit then the king of the Matsyas made him fight with his cook.

sa: शरैश्च बहुधा राजन् भीममार्च्छत् समन्ततः। प्रतिहत्य तु वेगेन भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद संक्रुद्धो विव्याध च शतैः शरैः।
en: And then, O king, he covered Bhima with numberless arrows from all sides. Then the mighty Bhima rending asunder Shakuni's arrows with great wrath hit him with a host of sharp arrows.

sa: जम्बुक उवाच शृणु मूषिक भद्रं ते नकुलो यदिहाब्रवीत्॥
en: The Jackal said : Blessed by you, O mouse. Listen to what the mongoose has said.

sa: ग्रसन्तमिव सैन्यानि प्रघसं वानराधिपः॥ सुग्रीवः सप्तपर्णेन निजघान जवेन च।
en: That lord of monkeys, Sugrīva, with a Saptaparma-swiftly slew Praghasa, who appeared to be devouring up the troops.

sa: तत एनं महावीर्यं महाकाया महाबलाः। द्वारपाला: समासाद्य हृष्टाः वचनमब्रुवन्॥
en: Thereupon some greatly powerful strong and huge-bodied frontier guards came to him and his cheerfully spoke to him.

sa: अतिकायेन सौमित्रिस्ताडितो युधि वक्षसि। सुस्राव रुधिरं तीव्र मदं मत्त इव द्विपः॥
en: Struck in the encounter by Atikaya, the son of Sumitra began to bleed copiously, like a mad elephant discharging the temporal jouice.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पुनः पुनरहं श्रोतुं कथां धर्मसमाश्रयाम्। पुण्यामिच्छामि धर्मज्ञ कथ्यमानां त्वया विभो॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O lord, O virtuous man, I desire to hear you again and again on sacred subjects relating to virtue and morals.

sa: ते वध्यमाना भीमेन धार्तराष्ट्राः पराङ्मुखाः। कर्णमासाद्य समरे स्थिता राजन् समन्ततः॥
en: Thus afflicted by Bhima, O monarch, the retreating bands of Dhritarashtra's army (all in a body moved towards Karna's flank).

sa: हन्यादमित्रं दानेन तथा पूर्वापकारिणम्। हन्यात् त्रीन् पञ्च सप्तेति परपक्षस्य सर्वशः॥
en: Destroy all the three, five and seven resources of the enemy; you must destroy them (enemies) by completely uprooting them.

sa: पिता माता च सर्वस्य जगतः शाश्वतो गुरुः। कं त्वद्य यजसे देवं पितरं कं न विद्महे॥
en: You are the father and the mother and the eternal preceptor of the universe. We know not who is that god or that Pitri to whom you are sacrificing to-day.

sa: ततोऽन्योन्यं प्रधावन्तः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे। ततः शब्देन महता प्रचकम्पे वसुन्धरा॥
en: Then the earth began to tremble with the loud din. Birds uttering fierce shrieks hovered over our heads.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स प्रसन्नमनास्तेन परिपृष्टो द्विजोत्तमः। उवाच वचनं तीक्ष्णं राजशास्त्रार्थदर्शनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That best of Brahmanas feel answered him in these pointed words, well-agreeing with the import of politics.

sa: प्रस्थाप्यन्तां हि विद्वांसो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। वाजिमेधार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं देशं पश्यन्तु यज्ञियम्॥
en: Let, therefore, learned Brahmanas knowing the Vedas look for a sacrificial spot for the celebration of the Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: प्रेष्याश्चेट्यश्च वध्वश्च बलस्थाश्चापि सर्वशः। बभूवुस्ते भृशं प्रीताः सर्वे चाहतवाससः॥
en: And wearing new clothes, all the servants, and maids, and females of the household, became exceedingly well pleased.

sa: दृष्ट्वा व्यवस्थितं भीमं तव पुत्रो महाबलः॥ चरंश्चित्रतरान् मार्गान् कौन्तेयमभिदुद्रुवे।
en: Seeing Bhima firmly stationed on the field, your powerful son, moving about, rushed towards that son of Kunti.

sa: ऋष्टिभिः शक्तिभिश्चैव सासिप्रासपरश्वधैः। संछन्ना पृथिवी जज्ञे कुसुमैः शबला इव॥
en: The warriors, O king, meeting one another, moved about in battle exercised with wrath and killing one another.

sa: युध्यतां तु ततस्तेषां वानराणां महात्मनाम्। रक्षसां संबभूवाथ बलरोषः सुदारुणः॥
en: As the high-soulcd monkeys and Raksasas taught on, their wrath vastly increase at sight of each other's forces.

sa: यत्नवांश्च स दुष्टात्मा मद्विनाशाय राघव। बहुशस्तत्प्रयुक्ताश्च वानरा निहता मया॥
en: That wicked wight, O Rāghava, seeks my life. Many monkeys commissioned by him have been slain by me.

sa: यदा तु तपसोगेण चकर्ष वसुधां नृपः। ततः शक्रोऽब्रवीद् देवान् राजर्षेर्यचिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Seeing the king till the soil with great perseverance, Shakra summoned the celestials and informed them of the king's work.

sa: यथा कर्म शुभं कृत्वा स्वर्गोपगमनं ध्रुवम्। यथा चायुर्बुवं सत्ये त्वयि धर्मस्तथा ध्रुवः॥
en: As the attainment of heaven is certain from good deeds, as long life is certain from truth, so virtue is certainly inseparable from you.

sa: विगर्हितं च नीचं च कथमार्योऽभिधास्यति। त्राहीति वचनं सीते यस्त्रायेत् त्रिदशानपि॥
en: How can he that can rescue the celestials themselves, utter, O Sītā, such a blame-worthy and base word as-save me?

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथमार्टिषेणो भगवान् विपुलं तप्तवांस्तपः। सिन्धुद्वीपः कथं चापि ब्राह्मण्यं लब्धवांस्तदा॥
en: Janamejaya said "Why did the worshipful Arshtishena practise the severest of penances? How also did Sindhudvipa acquire the dignity of a Brahmana?

sa: सा तमार्तस्वरं श्रुत्वा तव स्नेहेन मैथिली। गच्छ गच्छेति मामाशु रुदती भयविक्लवा:॥
en: Hearing those distressful accents, Maithili from affection [for you], breaking out into lamentations, and overwhelmed with fear, spoke to me, Off, off.

sa: ता वाचः स तदा श्रुत्वा तद्देशसदृशीर्नृप। ततो विममृशे राजा किं त्विदं दैवकारितम्॥
en: Hearing those cries, O king, uttered in voice of pain suitable to that place, the royal Yudhishthira asked himself, What perverse destiny is this?

sa: वाष्पवेगं तु सहसा नदीवेगमिवागतम्। धारयामास धैर्येण सुग्रीवो रामसंनिधौ॥
en: Sugrīva suddenly restrained, before Rāma, the force of tears, like to the tide of a river.

sa: तथैवान्धकवृष्णीनां तथैव च विशेषतः॥ कृष्णस्य च तथास्मत्तो मित्रमन्यन्न विद्यते।
en: Similarly the Andhakas and the Vrishnis, specially Krishna among the latter, cannot have any friend dearer than ourselves.

sa: स विस्फार्य तदा चापं किरीटी मृष्टकुण्डलः। नाम संश्रावयामास ननाद च महास्वनम्॥
en: Stretching his bow, (Atikāya) decked with a diadem wearing polished ear-rings, proclaimed his name (among the monkey-ranks) and shouted in lofty tones.

sa: अनड्वाहं तु यो दद्याद् बलवन्तं धुरंधरम्॥ स लिस्तरति दुर्गाणि स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति।
en: He who gives away a strong bull capable of drawing the plough, does not certainly meet with any calamity; he finally goes to heaven.

sa: तांस्तु वै पूजयामास कौन्तेयो विधिवद् द्विजान्। धौम्यं गुरुं पुरस्कृत्य ज्येष्ठं पितरमेव च।॥ सुमनोमोदकै रत्नैर्हिरण्येन च भूरिणा। गोभिर्वस्त्रैश्च राजेन्द्र विविधैश्च किमिच्छकैः॥
en: Accompanied by his priest Dhaumya and his eldest uncle, the son of Kunti gladly adored, with due rites, those Brahmanas with sweets, gems, and profuse gold, and kine and dresses, O king, and with various other articles that each desired.

sa: पुण्यां चेमामहं दिव्या प्रवृत्तामुत्तरायणे। देवीं रात्रिं नमस्यामि सिध्यतां मे मनोरथः॥
en: I bow to this holy, godly goddess night who is now on the northern solstice; let my wish be satisfied.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तमुवाच महाभागो भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। न भेतव्यं न भेतव्यं सौदेव व्येतु ते भयम्॥
en: Bhishma said Bharadvaja of great energy said to him who pleaded so piteously Do not fear! Do not fear! O son of Sudeva, let your fears be gone.

sa: वाचकाय च दातव्यं वस्त्रं धेनुहिरण्यकम्। वाचके परितुष्टे तु तुष्टाः स्युः सर्वदेवताः॥
en: Clothes, cows, and gold should be conferred upon him who chants this poem, for he being pleased all the deities remain satisfied.

sa: ततो ज्वलनमान→ हुत्वा सर्वे पृथक् पृथक्। जगृहुः कुशचीराणि चित्राणि कवचानि च॥
en: Then bringing fire, and every one having separately kindled one for himself, they took up mats of kusa grass and excellent mail-coats.

sa: अलम्बुषा मिश्रकेशी पुण्डरीकाथ वामना। उपानृत्यन्त भरतं भरद्वाजस्य शासनात्॥
en: And Alambusa, and Misrakesi, and Puņdarīka, and Vāmana danced before Bharata, at the command of Bharadvāja.

sa: वज्रहस्तो यथा शक्रः पाशहस्त इवान्तकः। शूलहस्तो बभौ युद्धे कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥
en: In that encounter, Kumbhakarņa armed with his dart in his hand, resembled the thunderhanded ſakra, or the noose-handed Destroyer himself.

sa: तदेव सर्वं सावित्र्या महाभाग्यं महर्षयः। धुमत्सेनाय नातृप्यन् कथयन्तः पुनः पुनः॥
en: was Those great sages were never satisfied in relating again and again of the high fortune of Savitri, to Dyumatsena.

sa: दिव्यं शतशलाकं च यज्ञार्थं काञ्चनं शुभम्। छत्रं देवावृधो दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणायास्थितो दिवम्॥
en: Devavriddha, too went to the celestial region by giving a hundred ribbed and excellent golden umbrella to a Brahmana for a sacrifice.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं भीष्मः सम्मन्त्र्य सह मन्त्रिभिः। निश्चित्य विससर्जेमां सत्यवत्या मते स्थितः॥
en: Bhishma, hearing those words and consulting with his ministers, came to a decision and following the opinion of Satyavati sent her away,

sa: मन्त्रे च निश्चये चैव षाड्गुण्यस्य च चिन्तने। विदुरं बुद्धिसम्पन्न प्रीतिमान् स समादिशत्॥
en: And he gladly appointed the highly intelligent Vidura for helping him with his advice and for looking after the sixfold requirements of the state.

sa: समं वचो निशम्यैव बलदेवस्य धीमतः। पुनरेव सभामध्ये सर्वे ते समुपाविशन्॥
en: Silence have been restored by the words of the intelligent Baladeva, they again all took their seats in that court.

sa: मनोः पुत्रश्च सुद्युम्नो लिखिताय महात्मने। दण्डमुद्धृत्य धर्मेण गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: Sudyumna the son of Manu, attained to the most blessed regions by duly punishing the high souled Likhita.

sa: यश्च मामभियुञ्जीत युद्धाय विगतज्वरः। तं शूलो भस्मसात्कृत्वा पुनरेष्यति ते करम्।।।।।
en: Reducing to cinders the person that shall rashly enter upon conflict with you, this dart shall return to your hand.

sa: यत्र यत्र तु पाण्डूनां द्रोणो द्रावयते चमूम्॥ किरछरसहस्राणि तत्र तत्र प्रयाम्यहम्।
en: In whatever quarter Drona had sought to rout the troops of the Pandavas, in that quarter I proceeded, shooting myriads of shafts.

sa: सर्वसत्वानि यानीह स्थावराणि चराणि च। महता पांसुवर्षेण विलयं सर्वतोऽगमन्।।।
en: And all creatures mobile and immobile, wherever they might be, shall be destroyed with this downpour of dust.

sa: अभ्ययात् सहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते माधवः प्रभुः। विधुन्वानो धनुः श्रेष्ठं चोदयंश्चैव वाजिनः॥
en: Quickly proceeded to the spot where that mighty-descendant of Madhu's race, was fighting. He came stretching his bow and urging his steeds.

sa: त्वया पुनरनार्येण पूर्वं पार्थेन निर्जितः॥ यदा तदा हतः शूरः सौमदत्तिः प्रतापवान्।
en: When Partha had already vanquished him, it was only then that by an unfair means you slew the puissant son of Somadatta.

sa: इमं स्तवं प्रयतमनाः समाधिना पठेदिहान्योऽपि वरं समर्थयन्। तत् तस्य दद्याच्च रविर्मनीषितं तदाप्नुयाद् यद्यपि तत् सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: He, who with the desire of obtaining a boon, recites this hymn concentrating his mind with ascetic abstraction, obtains it from the sun, however difficult of acquisition it may be.

sa: सर्वकामैश्च सम्पूर्णे दत्त्वा वेश्म हिरण्मयम्। मौन्द्रल्याय गतः स्वर्गे शतद्युम्नो महीपतिः॥
en: The king Satadyumna went to heaven by giving to Mudgala a golden palace filled with all the objects of desire.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। प्रहृष्टवदनः श्रीमान् भ्रातरं पार्श्वतः स्थितम्॥
en: Hearing those words, the effulgent Rāma, with a delighted countenance, spoke to his younger brother, Laksmana-~-sitting by him.

sa: इयं च कन्या राजर्षे किमर्थं वनमागता। कस्य चेयं तव च का भवतीच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: O royal sage, why is the lady come to the forest, whose daughter is she and what is she to you? I desire to know it.

sa: भक्ष्यभोज्यस्य च कृतान् राशयः पर्वतोपमान्। शाण्डिल्याय पुरा दत्त्वा सुमन्युर्दिवमास्थितः॥
en: Formerly, King Sumanyu by giving to Shandilya heaps of food resembling a hill, went to the celestial region.

sa: कुमारो देवगर्भाभः स तत्राशु व्यवर्धत। षड्वर्ष एव बालः स कण्वाश्रमपदं प्रति॥ सिंहव्याघ्रान् वराहांश्च महिषांश्च गजांस्तथा। बबन्ध वृक्षे बलवानाश्रमस्य समीपतः॥
en: Like a celestial child, he began daily to grow up. When he grew six years old, he was so strong that he seized and bound tigers, boars, buffaloes and elephants to the trees that stood near the hermitage.

sa: प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा मतङ्गोऽपि सम्प्राप्तः स्थानमुत्तमम्। एवमेतत् परं स्थानं ब्राह्मण्यं नाम भारत। तच्च दुष्प्रापमिह वै महेन्द्रवचनं यथा॥
en: You may thus see, O Bharata that the dignity of a Brahmana is very high. That dignity is incapable of being acquired here as said by the great Indra himself.

sa: तेषां श्रुत्वा सभापालो भेरी सांनाहिकी ततः। समाजघ्ने महाघोषां जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृताम्॥
en: Having heard this, the Sabhapala blew his golden decked trumpet of loud blare, calling every one to arms.

sa: निमित्तानि च धन्यानि यथा भीम वदन्ति माम्। निहते सैन्धवे पापे पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥
en: These auspicious omens also indicate my victory. When the sinful ruler of the Sindhus will be slain by the high-souled son of Pandu (Arjuna).

sa: दत्त्वा शतसहस्रं तु गवां राजा भगीरथः। सवत्सानां कोहलाय गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: King Bhagiratha acquired the most blessed regions by giving hundreds and thousands of kine with their young one to Kohala.

sa: शिष्टानां चरितं ह्येतत् कीर्तितं मे युधिष्ठिर। दानयज्ञप्रजासगैरेते हि दिवमास्थिताः॥
en: These people have acquired the celestial region by their charities and by performing sacrifices and by procreating children.

sa: भारद्वाजं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्दुःसहं नवभिः शरैः। विकर्णे पञ्चविंशत्या चित्रसेनं च सप्तभिः॥
en: Satyaki pierced the son of Bharadvaja with three arrows, Dussaha with nine, Vikarna with twenty-five, Chitrasena with seven.

sa: दिशः पर्याकुलाः सर्वास्तिमिरेणेव संवृताः। न ग्रहो नासिनक्षत्रं प्रचकाशे न किंचन॥
en: And the cardinal points are distressed, and appear enveloped in darkness. And no planet or star is to be seen.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच योऽसौ कर्णेन वीरस्य वार्ष्णेयस्य समागमः। हते तु भूरिश्रवसि सैन्धवे च निपातिते॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How, after Bhurisrava and the king of Sindhu being slain, the heroic Karna and the scion of Vrishni's race, came incontact with each other.

sa: त्रिशङ्कुरोहिताङ्गश्च बृहस्पतिबुधावपि । दारुणाः सममभ्येत्य ग्रहाः सर्वे व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Trisanku, Lohitanga, Brhaspati, Budha and the other Grahas getting at the Moon, remained with fierce aspects.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे प्रातिष्ठन्त महौजसः। शकुन्तलां पुरस्कृत्य दुष्यन्तस्य पुरं प्रति॥
en: The greatly effulgent disciples (of Kanva), having promised to do it, started with Shakuntala and her son towards the city of Hastinapur.

sa: व्यमृद्न् समरे राजंस्तुरगाश्च नरान् रणे। एवं ते बहुधा राजन् प्रत्यमृद्न् परस्परम्॥
en: And also, O king, horses again crushed the foot-soldiers in that battle. Thus, o king, they crushed one another in various modes.

sa: तथैव च रथान् राजन् प्रममर्द रणे गजः। रथाश्चैव समासाद्य पतितांस्तुरगान् भुवि॥
en: Also, o king, in that battle one elephant crushed many cars, and car also, passing over fallen steeds, crushed them in battle.

sa: तत्र वृद्धो महामात्रः सिद्धार्थो नाम नामतः। शुचिर्बहुमतो राज्ञः कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then a notable, aged, pure-spirited personage held in high esteem by the monarch, named Siddhartha, addressed Kaikeyi, saying.

sa: तं द्रोणः सप्त सप्तत्या जघान निशितैः शरैः। दुर्मर्षणो द्वादशभिर्दुःसहो दशभिः शरैः॥
en: Then Drona pierced Satyaki with seven and seventy shafts of great sharpness; Durmursana pierced him with twelve and Dussaha with ten shafts.

sa: तत्र गच्छस्व भद्रं ते ब्रूयाश्चैनं वचो मम। अभिवाद्य च तं मूर्धां तपोवृद्धं दृढव्रतम्॥
en: Go there and may you fare well. Tell him these words of mine after saluting that old devotee of firm vows by bowing down your head.

sa: स मातामहमापृच्छ्य मातुलं च युधाजितम्। रथमारुह्य भरत: शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ॥
en: Then after speaking with his maternal grandfather and uncle, Yudhajit, Bharata ascending a car, set out with Satrughna.

sa: भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपो द्रौणिः कर्णो भूरिश्रवास्तथा। प्राग्ज्योतिषाधिपः शल्यः सिन्धुराजो जयद्रथः॥
en: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Drona's son and Bhurishrava, Shalya, the king of the Pragjyotish and Jayadratha, the king of the Sindhus,

sa: यदि त्वं हि पुरा राजन्निदं राज्यमवाप्तवान्। ध्रुवं प्राप्स्याम च वयं राज्यमप्यवशे जने॥
en: O king, however the people might be unfavourable towards us if you had obtained the kingdom before, we would have certainly succeeded to it.

sa: मानवा वापि जेतारः कृष्णयोः सन्ति केचन। पितामहपुरोगाश्च देवाः सिद्धाश्च तं विदुः॥ तयोः : प्रभावमतुलं शृणु युद्धं तु तत् तथा। सात्यकिं विरथं दृष्ट्वा कर्ण चाभ्युद्यतं रणे॥
en: Nor men can conquer Krishna and Arjuna. Even the celestials with the (original) Grandsire (Brahma) at their head and the Siddhas are aware of the matchless strength of those two. Now hear about the battle as it took place. Seeing Satyaki without a car and Karna prepared for the encounter.

sa: शक्यः कर्तुमयं यज्ञः सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता। नापराधो भवेत् कष्टो यद्यस्मिन् क्रतुसत्तमे॥
en: Surely every king is competent to perform this sacrifice yet care must be taken that no default occurs in it.

sa: श्रूयतां तु प्रभो तत्त्वं दिव्यतां चात्मनो नृप। निर्माणं च शरीरस्य ततो धैर्यमवाप्नुहि॥
en: O king, of lord, know the truth, the celestials origin of your birth and the make up of your body; and then assume patience.

sa: दध्मौ शङ्ख महानादमाषभेणथ माधवः। दारुकोऽवेत्य सदेशं श्रुत्वा शङ्खस्य च स्वनम्॥
en: Madhava loudly blew his conch in the Rishava note. Hearing the loud sound of the conch, Daruka understood the hint.

sa: सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रांश्चतुरोऽमितविक्रमान्। यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता॥
en: Since you purpose so virtuously for obtaining offspring, you shall obtain four sons of immeasurable prowess.

sa: हृदि कृत्वा स बहुशस्तमलंकारमुत्तमम्। निशश्वास भृशं सर्पो बिलस्थ इव रोषितः॥
en: And placing the elegant ornaments on his bosom, he sighed again and again, like an enraged serpent in a hole.

sa: आविद्ध्यन्तमरिं प्रेक्ष्य धार्तराष्ट्रोऽथ पाण्डवम्। गदामतुलवेगां तां विस्मितः सम्बभूवह॥
en: Seeing his foe, the son of Pandu, thus whirling his mace, the impetuous Duryodhana was amazed.

sa: एकोऽहमस्मीति च मन्यसे त्वं न हृच्छयं वेत्सि मुनि पुराणम्। यो वेदिता कर्मणः पापकस्य तस्यान्तिके त्वं वृजिनं करोपि॥
en: You think that you alone know what you did. But do you not know that the great Omniscient One dwells in your heart. He knows all your sins and you sin in his presence.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे भीमः सहदेवश्च भारत। चेरतुः कदनं संख्ये कुर्वन्तौ सुमहाबलौ॥
en: Then Bhima, worked up with rage and the brave Sahadeva, both very powerful, moved about in that battle making a great onslaught.

sa: स हि भीष्मं शांतनवं धृतराष्ट्रं च धर्मवित्। सपुत्रं विविधैर्भोगैर्योजयिष्यति पूजयन्॥
en: Worshipping the of Shantanu, Bhishma and virtuous Dhritarashtra, he (Yudhisthira) will certainly maintain Bhishma and Dhritarashtra with all his sons."

sa: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीविजयो भूतिर्बुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
en: Wherever exist the Lord of Yoga Srikrishna and the great bowman Arjuna, there certainly do wealth, victory and glory exist.

sa: अभ्यधावत वेगेन पुनः पुनररिंदम। तं तु सक्रोधमालोक्य सात्यकिः प्रत्युयुध्यत॥
en: Rushed furiously again and again (towards him.) O chastiser of foes, seeing him greatly enraged, Satyaki smote him.

sa: राजा चरति चेद् धर्मं देवत्वायैव कल्पते। स चेदधर्मं चरति नरकायैव गच्छति॥
en: If the king acts piously, he attains to the dignity of a god. If, however, he acts unrighteously, he sinks into hell.

sa: लोमश उवाच समुद्रं ते समाश्रित्य वारुणं निधिसम्भसः। कालेयाः सम्प्रवर्तन्त त्रैलोक्यस्य विनाशने॥
en: Lomasha said : Living in the ocean, the abode of Varuna, the Kalkeyas began their operations for the destruction of the worlds.

sa: ततः पर्याकुलं सर्व न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। तथा सात्यकिना वीरे विस्थे सूतजे कृते॥
en: Then such a confusion followed (on the battlefield) that nothing could be seen. The heroic son of charioteer being thus made carless by Satyaki.

sa: रुक्मनिष्कसहस्र द्वे षोडशाश्वशतानि च। सत्कृत्य केकयीपुत्रं केकयो धनमादिशत्॥
en: Honouring the son of Kaikeyi, Kekaya gave him two thousand nishkas and six hundred : horses.

sa: यदि मे याचमानाया वचनं न करिष्यसि। दुष्यन्त शतधा मूर्धा ततस्तेऽद्य स्फुटिष्यति॥
en: O Dushyanta, If you refuse what I ask you to do, your head will to day be divided into a thousand pieces.

sa: नाशकुवंस्ततो हन्तुं सात्यकिं प्रवरा रथाः। द्रौणिश्च कृतवर्मा च तथैवान्ये महारथाः॥
en: Satyaki, yet those foremost of car-warriors were unable to kill him. The son of Drona, Kritavarman and other great car-warriors.

sa: यदागमवतः पुंसस्तदपत्यं प्रजायते। तत् तारयति संतत्या पूर्वप्रेतान् पितामहान्॥
en: The son, that is born to a wise man, rescues the spirits of his deceased ancestors.

sa: संजय उवाच न्यवर्तत॥ तानभिद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवांस्तावकं बलम्। दुर्योधन महाराज वारयामास सर्वशः॥ योधांश्च स्वबलं चैव समन्ताद् भरतर्षभ। क्रोशतस्तव पुत्रस्य न स्म राजन्
en: Sanjaya said Beholding the Pandava troops rush upon your army, O monarch, Duryodhana checked his soldiers on all sides, O best of Bharatas. Although your son O king, cried at the top of his voice still his flying troops refused to stop.

sa: एतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं भविद्भर्वचनं मम। अनुज्ञाप्याथ तान् राजा यथेष्टं गम्यतामिति॥
en: You should always remember those words of mine.' The king then asked them to go where they liked.

sa: अस्मिन् कलियुगे त्वस्ति पुनः कौतूहलं मम। समाकुलेषुधर्मेषु किं नु शेषं भविष्यति॥
en: I am very curious to know what will happen in the Kali Yuga and when virtue will be destroyed, what would remain.

sa: ततो देवाः सहिताः सर्व एव विन्ध्यं समागम्य महाद्रिराजम्। निवारयामासुरुपायतस्तं न च स्म तेषां वचनं चकार॥
en: Thereupon all the assembled celestials came to Vindhya, the great king of mountains and tried to dissuade him from what he was doing. But he did not heed their words.

sa: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्। उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः।।।।
en: Hearing those wondrous words of Rāma, Agastya having asceticism for his wealth, delightedly said.

sa: अतः कष्टतरं किं नु द्रष्टव्यं हि भविष्यति। यत् पश्यामि महीसुप्तान् भ्रातृनद्य सुमन्दभाक्॥
en: ever "Alas! what more painful sight can I see then what I see now, my brothers sleeping on the ground! O unfortunate am I!

sa: दुर्योधनं निशान्ते च कर्णो वैकर्तनोऽब्रवीत्। स्मयन्निवाञ्जलिं कृत्वा पार्थिवं हेतुमद् वचः॥
en: At the end of the night, the son of the sun, Karna, thus smilingly spoke to Duryodhana with joined hands.

sa: राजन् विषनिमित्ता च न ते पीडा भविष्यति। संग्रमेषु च राजेन्द्र शश्वज्जयमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: O king! you shall feel no uneasiness owing to my venom. O best of kings! you shall ever gain victory in battles.

sa: न कालोऽद्य विषादस्य भयस्य मरणस्य वा। परिष्वज्याब्रवीच्चैनं भुजाभ्यां स महाभुजः॥
en: Therefore this is no time for grief or fear or death.” Having with his arms embraced that mighty armed hero,

sa: तां सुमध्यां पृथुश्रोणी प्रतिमां काञ्चनीमिव। प्राप्तेयं देवकन्येति दृष्ट्वा सम्मेनिरे जनाः॥
en: Seeing that slender-waisted damsel of robust hips and looking like a golden image, people thought "we have got a goddess."

sa: अब्रुवन् सैनिकास्तत्र दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्य विक्रमम्। अद्य राजा धार्तराष्ट्रः कृतार्थो वै भविष्यति॥
en: Then the soldiers, beholding the prowess of Drona said, "Today the royal son of Dhritarashtra will attain the fruition of his desire.

sa: तां तु पद्मपलाशाक्षीं ज्वलन्तीमिव तेजसा। न कश्चिद् वरयामास तेजसा प्रतिवारितः॥
en: And oppressed by her, energy none could marry that girl of lotus-like eyes who seemed as if blazing in splendour.

sa: हा तात हा पुत्रक कान्त मित्र हा जीवितेशाङ्ग हतं सुपुण्यम्। रक्षोभिरेवं बहुधा ब्रुवद्भिः शब्दः कृतो घोरतरः सुभीमः॥
en: O father! O son! O love! O friend! O lord of my life and frame! all our religious merit is abolished "Indulging in various lamentations, the Rākşas thus created a mighty and frightful uproar."

sa: मत्स्यराजसमक्षं तु तस्य धूर्तस्य पश्यतः। कीचकेन परामृष्टा का नु जीवति मादृशी॥
en: Who else like me, can live having been kicked by Kichaka in the very presence of the wicked king of the Matsya's?

sa: एवं पूर्वापरान् क्लेशानतितिक्षन्त पाण्डवाः। बलीयांसोऽपि सन्तो यत् तत् सर्वं कुरवो विदुः॥
en: The Pandavas will quietly bear similar insults offered before and after that though they are strong enough. All this the Kauravas know.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं स विद्ध्वा तु शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। युगन्धरं तु भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: But Drona, having pierced Yudhishthira with close-jointed shafts, overthrew Yugandhara from his niche in the car with a broad-headed arrow.

sa: सा हैमं रथमास्थाय स्थविरैः सचिवैर्वृता। तपोवनानि रम्याणि राजर्षीणां जगाम ह॥
en: Seated on a car of gold and surrounded by the ministers, she visited the delightful hermitage of the royal sages.

sa: एवं तीर्थेषु सर्वेषु धनोत्सर्गं नृपात्मजा। कुर्वती द्विजमुख्यानां तं तं देशं जगाम ह॥
en: Thus giving away riches in all the Tirthas, the king's daughter travelled over all those places inhabited by the foremost of the twiceborn ones.

sa: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः। ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः॥
en: And he, who will study this holy conversation between us, will offer to Me the sacrifice of knowledge. This is my opinion.

sa: मुक्तामणिचितं चेदं रमणीयं विभूषितम्। धरण्यां पतितं सौम्य कस्य भग्नं महद् धनुः॥
en: O gentle one, whose is this snapped bow lying on the breast of the earth adorned and crested with pearls and diamonds?

sa: भ्राता भ्रातरमन्वेतु पिता पुत्रेण युज्यताम्। स्मयमानाः समायान्तु पाञ्चालाः कुरुभिः सह।॥
en: Let brother follow brother and let father unite with son. Let the Panchala join the Kurus with a smiling face.

sa: तस्या निमित्तं सीताया द्वयोर्विवदमानयोः। बभूव युद्धं सौमित्रे घोरं राक्षसयोरिह।॥
en: O Saumitrī, there took place a terrible conflict between the Rākṣasas, fighting with each other on Sita's account.

sa: इयं वारिपथे युक्ता नौरप्सु सुखगामिनी। मोचयिष्यति वः सर्वानस्माद् देशान्न संशयः॥
en: "This boat is ready on the waters. It will glide pleasantly on. It will surely carry away from these regions."

sa: एतद्धि परमं श्रेयो मन्येऽहं तव भारत। दुर्योधनप्रभृतयः पुत्रा राजन् यथा तव॥ तथैव पाण्डवेयास्ते पुत्रा राजन् न संशयः। तेषु चेदहितं किंचिन्मन्त्रयेयुरतद्विदः॥ मन्त्रिणस्ते न च श्रेयः प्रपश्यन्ति विशेषतः। अथ ते हृदये राजन् विशेष: स्वेषु वर्तते। ते॥ अन्तरस्थं वितृण्वानाः श्रेयः कुर्युर्न ते ध्रुवम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, I consider what they have said is highly beneficial to you. O king, the Pandavas are certainly your sons as much as Duryodhana and others. Therefore, those ministers who give you any advice that is fraught with evil intentions towards the Pandavas do not really look after your interest. O king, if there is any partiality (for your sons) in your heart, it is certain that they who seek to excite it do you no good.

sa: संस्मृत्य पूर्वभूतिं च निर्वेदं परमं गतः। न भक्षयति मांसानि परैरुपहृतान्यपि॥
en: Remembering his pristine prosperity, he was filled with grief and abstained from meat even when brought before him by others,

sa: नागानां शृणु शब्दं च पत्तीनां च सहस्रशः। सादिनां द्रवतां चैव शृणु कम्पयतां महीम्॥
en: Hear also the roars of elephants the yells of infantry and the cries of hoses-men, as they proceed causing the earth to tremble underneath their tread.

sa: धर्मं यो बाधतेधर्मो न सधर्मः कुधर्म तत्। अविरोधात् तु योधर्मः सधर्मः सत्यविक्रम॥
en: The virtue, that stands in the way of another virtue, is (really) unrighteousness. O truthful king, that virtue true virtue which is not conflicting.

sa: अशीते विद्यते शीतं शीते शीतं न विद्यते। अवृष्टिरतिवृष्टिश्च व्याधिश्चाप्याविशेत् प्रजाः॥
en: Cold appears during the summer months, and disappears in its proper season. Drought and flood and pestilence attack the people.

sa: स तत्तथा भग्नमवेक्ष्य शूलं चुकोप रक्षोधपतिर्महात्मा। उत्पाट्य लङ्कामलयात्सशृङ्ग जधान सुग्रीवमुपेत्य तेन।६६।।
en: Then the mighty-minded lord of Rákşasas seeing the dart thus severed, uprooted a peak from the Malaya and with it smote Sugrīva.

sa: तस्य ब्रह्मन् रुरोः सर्वं चरितं भूरितेजसः। विस्तरेण प्रवक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु त्वमशेषतः॥
en: I shall tell you at length, O Brahmana, the history of the resplendently energetic Ruru. Listen to it in detail.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं तैश्चोदितो राजन् स विप्रः पुरुषर्षभैः। कथयामास तत् सर्व द्रौपदीसम्भवं तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, having been thus asked by those best of men, the Brahmana narrated in detail the account of the birth of Draupadi.

sa: नागा मेघनिभा राजन् क्षरन्त इव तोयदाः। नैते जातु निवर्तेरन् प्रेषिता हस्तिसादिभिः॥
en: These elephants shedding the temporal juice like clouds pouring rain, they never turn back when goaded on by those on their backs.

sa: ततः साम्बाय राजेन्द्र क्षेमवृद्धिरपि स्वयम्। मुमोच मायाविहितं शरजालं महत्तरम्॥
en: O king of kings, thereupon Kshemavriddhi, aided by his power of illusion, poured a great shower of arrows.

sa: जग्राह च मुनिश्रेष्ठः कृपाविष्टः पुपोष च। ववृधे सा वरारोहा तस्याश्रमपदे शुभे॥
en: Out of compassion, took it home and brought it up. The lovely child grew up in the hermitage of the great Rishi.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच यदि नेच्छसि मत्तस्त्वं वरं भद्रे शुचिस्मिते। इमं मन्त्रं गृहाण त्वमाह्वानाय दिवौकसाम्॥
en: The Brahmana said: O gentle girl of sweet smiles, if you do not desire for boons from me, then take this Mantra for invoking the gods.

sa: आकाशमिव दुष्पारं सागरं प्रेक्ष्य वानराः। विषेदुः सहिताः सर्वे कथं कार्यमिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Seeing the sea, incapable of being crossed even as the sky, all the monkeys began to lament, saying,-What is to be done?

sa: त्वां हि मायामयं दृष्ट्वा काञ्चनं जातविस्मया। आनयैनमिति क्षिप्रं रामं वक्ष्यति मैथिली॥
en: Vaidehi, being struck with wonder seeing you a golden deer capable of illusions, shall request Rāma to get you soon for her.

sa: प्रविवेश महाबाहुरनुज्ञातो महर्षिणा। वेश्म तद् रत्नसम्पूर्ण भरतः कैकयीसुतः॥ अनुजग्मुश्च ते सर्वे मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः। बभूवुश्च मुदा युक्तास्तं दृष्ट्वा वेश्मसंविधिम्॥
en: Permitted by the Maharsi, Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, entered that mansion abounding in gems. And he was followed by the counsellors and the priests; and the latter beholding the arrangements of the palace, were filled with delight.

sa: स फालपिटकं गृह्य गिरिदुर्गाण्यलोकयत्। दिशः सर्वास्त्वनुचरन् स यथा पापकर्मकृत्॥ इत्येनमत्यजद् राजा सगरो वै सुधार्मिकः। रामः किंमकरोत् पापं येनैवमुपरुध्यते॥
en: Thereupon that worker of iniquity went to the forest and went about seeing mountain fastnesses. Thus did the virtuous king Sagara renounce his son. But what offence has Rāma committed that he is to be banished?

sa: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च। शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौव्युदस्य च॥
en: Having a pure mind, restraining his self by constancy, renouncing all objects of sense, and casting off affection and aversion.

sa: अभिव्यक्तः परेषां च कृत्स्नो भुवि पराजयः। अह्ना टेकेन भीष्मोऽयं प्रयुतं हन्ति भारत॥
en: Our defeat and the success of enemies, too, are proclaimed in the world. In one day this Bhishma kills ten thousand (enemies), 0 Bharata.

sa: परावरज्ञो यश्च स्यात् यथा त्वं मनुजाधिप। स एव व्यसनं प्राप्य न विषीदितुमर्हति ॥
en: O lord of men, he that like to you understands the nature of the soul and its environment coming by any calamity, ought not to despond.

sa: ततो रामस्तु विजयी पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः॥ प्रविवेशाश्रमं वीरो लक्ष्मणेनाभिपूजितः।
en: Then the victorious and heroic, Rāma, honoured by the Maharsis, entered the asylum, worshipped by Lakṣmaṇa.

sa: अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गोविन्दोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्। एष गच्छामि सुक्षिप्रं यत्र भीमो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Hearing these words of Arjuna, Govinda replied him (thus)-"Off I go towards the spot where Bhima has taken his post.”

sa: प्रोषिते मयि यत् पापं मात्रा मत्कारणात् कृतम्। क्षुद्रया तदनिष्टं मे प्रसीदतु भवान् मम ॥
en: The sin that in my absence from home has been perpetrated by my mean-minded mother does not find favour in my sight. Be you therefore propitious to me.

sa: ततस्ते तं महावीर्या राजानः पर्यवारयन्। जिगीषन्तो नरव्याघ्र पूर्वं विनिकृता युधि॥
en: Defeated in battle before, those Kshatriyas of great energy, moved by the desire of victory, surrounded that foremost of men.

sa: नहि कंचन पश्यामो राघवस्यागुणं वयम्। दुर्लभो ह्यस्य निरयः शशाङ्कस्येव कल्मषम्॥ अथवा देवि त्वं कंचिद् दोषं पश्यसि राघवे। तमद्य ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन तदा रामो विवास्यते॥
en: We do not find any fault whatever in Rāghava. Rare is his fault even like the spot on the Moon. Or it may be, O exalted lady, that you perceive some fault in Rāghava. Do you, if so, unfold it; and then let Rāma be banished,

sa: राज्यांशश्चाभ्यनुज्ञातो यो मे पित्रा पुराभवत्। न स लभ्यः पुनर्जातु मयि जीवति केशव॥
en: The share of the kingdom that was given them in early days will not be regained by them during my life time, O Keshava.

sa: क्व चारण्यं क्व च क्षात्रं व जटाः क्व च पालनम्। ईदृशं व्याहतं कर्म न भवान् कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: Where is the forest? And where is Ksatriya morality? Where are matted locks? And where is your government of the country? It behoves you not to act in such an untoward way.

sa: अथ क्लेशजमेव त्वं धर्म चरितुमिच्छसि। धर्मेण चतुरो वर्णान् पालयन् क्लेशमाप्नुहि ॥
en: But if you be bent upon practising this austere morality, do you undergo this trouble, after having righteously ruled the four orders.

sa: अथवा पृष्ठतः कृत्वा वनमेव भवानितः। गमिष्यति गमिष्यामि भवता सार्धमप्यहम्॥
en: But, if disregarding my solicitations, you wend from here to the forest, I shall go along with you.

sa: शक्रस्य तु सभायां तु देवाः संकीर्तिता मुने। उद्देशतश्च गन्धर्वा विविधाश्च महर्षयः॥
en: O Rishi, you have said that in the Sabha of Shakra (Indra) are the celestials, the Gandharvas and the various great Rishis.

sa: अन्ववैश्यैतदुभयं क्षेमं स्याद् यत् कुलस्य नः। तद् वै कर्तुं परः कालो मातरेष भवेत् तव॥
en: O mother, taking into your consideration both these two calamities, the time has come for you to do that which will be for the good of our race.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। वासवस्य च संवादं शुकस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: Bhishma said “Regarding it, this ancient legend, the story of Vasava and the great Shuka, is cited as an illustration.

sa: शाश्वती खलु ते कीर्तिर्लोकाननु चरिष्यति। यस्त्वं कृच्छ्रगतं रामं प्रत्यानयितुमिच्छसि॥
en: Your eternal fame will certainly range this world, since you wish to bring back Rāma passing through misfortune.

sa: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः। यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते॥
en: Actions cannot be absolutely a abandoned by man; therefore he, who abandons the fruit of actions, is a true Tyagi.

sa: एवं सम्बोधितस्तेन शोकोपहतचेतनः। त्यज्य शोकं च मोहं च रामो धैर्यमुपागमत्॥
en: Being thus accosted by Lakşmaņa, Rāma having his mind stricken with sorrow, attained to mental quietude renouncing grief and dolour.

sa: ते वयं स्मरमाणास्तान् विनिकारान् पृथग्विधान्। क्रोधाग्निना दह्यमाना न शेमहि सदा निशि॥
en: We, remembering those various occasions of humiliation, are ever consumed with the fire of wrath and at night can never enjoy sleep.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः॥ राजन् मर्मसु मर्मज्ञो विव्याध निशितैः शरैः। ननाद बलवन्नादं कम्पयन्निव रोदसी॥
en: Then, O king, taking up another bow, Bhima, who knew where the vital parts are, pierced the son of the charioteer to the very vitals with sharpened arrows.

sa: निवर्तस्व महाबाहो कुरुष्व वचनं मम। न हि ते धर्मलोपोऽस्ति न च ते धर्षणा कृता॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, therefore, desist from your purpose. Do what I say. Your virtue has suffered no diminution and you have not also shown any disregard towards me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा सम्प्रतस्थे कणिकः सवगृहं ततः। धृतराष्ट्रोऽपि कौरव्यः शोकार्तः समपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this Kanika went away to his house and the descendant of Kuru Dhritarashtra become pensive and sad.

sa: अङ्गदानि च चित्राणि केयूराणि शुभानि च। प्रयच्छति सखी तुभ्यं भार्यायै गच्छती वनम्॥
en: On the eve of her going to the woods, she presents your self and your wife with Angadas of curious workmanship and elegant Keyuras.

sa: पितृलोकगतश्चैव त्वया विप्र पिता मम। दृष्टः पाण्डुर्महाभागः कथं वापि समागतः॥
en: O Brahmana, how did you meet with my father, the illustrious Pandu, now living in the region of the Pitris?

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः। अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा गुहो गहनगोचरः॥
en: Hearing these words of the intelligent son of the king, Guha well acquainted with the forest, said with joined hands.

sa: स ताञ्छित्त्वा शितैर्बाणैर्लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। आददे निशितं बाणं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ॥
en: Having severed them with sharpened shafts, Lakşmaņa— slayer of hostile heroes-took up a sharpened arrow, as if flaming in energy.

sa: प्राकारैश्च पुरद्वारैः प्रासादैश्च पृथग्विधैः। नगराणि न शोभन्ते हीनानि ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः॥
en: Cities adorned with walls and gates and palaces lose their beauty if they are not inhabited by Brahmanas.

sa: जातस्वेदस्ततो रामो रोषरक्तान्तलोचनः। निर्बिभेद सहस्रेण बाणानां समरे खरम्॥
en: Then Rāma perspiring, with eyes reddened in wrath, pierced Khara in battle with a thousand shafts.

sa: अज्ञातवासं वसता विराटनगरे तदा। द्रौपद्याः प्रियकामेन केवलं बाहुसंश्रयात्॥ तु गूढभावं समाश्रित्य कीचकः सगणो हतः।
en: While living secretly in the city of Virata, he depending merely on the strength of his own arms, slew secretly, to satisfy Draupadi, Kichaka with all his relations,

sa: धर्मार्थयुक्तं तु महीपतित्वं ग्रामेऽपि कस्मिंश्चिदयं बुभूषेत्। पित्र्यं हि राज्यं विदितं नृपाणां यथापकृष्टं धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रैः॥ मिथ्योपचारेण यथा ह्यनेन कृच्छ्रे महत् प्राप्तमसह्यरूपम्। न चापि पार्थो विजितो रणे तैः स्वतेजसा धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रैः॥
en: He would rather prefer the rightful lordship of some single village. It is known to all the kings (assembled here) how he has been robbed of his ancestral kingdom with the help of a mean trick by the sons of Dhritarashtra by whom the son of Pritha has not been vanquished through prowess borne by him.

sa: तस्य चार्तस्य तैर्वाक्यैश्चोद्यमानः पुनः पुनः। आक्रन्दे तत्र कौन्तेयश्चिन्तयामास दुःखितः॥
en: Being repeatedly urged by the weeping words of the Brahmana, the son of Kunti (Arjuna) pondered in sorrow.

sa: हत्वा तत् पुरुषानीकं भीमः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं पुरस्कृस्य पुनस्तस्थौ महाबलः।
en: Having killed that brave division, the powerful Bhima, of invincible prowess, once more stood, with Dhrishtadyumna before him.

sa: सर्वे नानुगतं दुर्वेदा वा सुवेदा वा प्राकृताः संस्कृतास्तथा। ब्राह्मणा नावमन्तव्या भस्मच्छन्ना इवाग्नयः॥
en: Whether learned in the Vedas or not, whether pure or impure, they should never be insulted, for Brahmanas are like fires, 'covered with ashes.

sa: अथ दीर्घेण कालेन ब्राह्मणस्य विशाम्पते। कस्यचित् तस्करा जह्वः केचिद् गा नृपसत्तम॥
en: O king, O best of monarchs, many days after (it so happened) that a robber stole some kine of a certain Brahmanas,

sa: नेदं युक्तं महीपाल यादृशं वै त्वमुक्तवान्। अधर्मश्च परो राजन् पारुष्यं च निरर्थकम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O lord of the earth, what you have said does not suit you, O king, it is highly sinful and needlessly cruel.

sa: ते तया तैश्च सा वीरैः पतिभिः सह पञ्चभिः। बभूव परमप्रीता नागैर्भोवती यथा॥
en: She became exceedingly happy in her five heroic husbands as the Sarasvati in elephants; and they (the Pandavas) also were exceedingly happy in her.

sa: द्वन्द्वे यस्य न तिष्ठन्ति दैवतान्यपि संयुगे। स कस्माद्रावणो युद्धे भयमाहारयिष्यति॥
en: He before whom even the gods cannot stay in the battle field, how can that Råvaņa ever come by fear?

sa: एवं तैर्वानरैः शूरैः शूरास्ते रजनीचराः। द्वन्द्वे विमथितास्तत्र दैत्या इव दिवौकसैः।॥
en: Like the celestials warring against the Daityas, the heroic monkeys warred on and confounded the valiant rangers of the night.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कौन्तेयः पित्रा ज्येष्ठेन भारत। पस्पर्श सर्वगात्रेषु सौहार्दात् तं शनैस्तदा॥
en: Thus addressed, O Bharata, by the eldest brother of his father, the son of Kunti, from affection, gently touched every part of his body.

sa: आख्यानं य इदं युक्तः पठेत् पर्वणि पर्वणि। न मूर्ख जनयेत् पुत्रं न भवेच्च निराकृतिः॥
en: The man who reads this discourse with rapt attention on every Parva day, will not beget an ignorant and wicked son. He will never be shorn of fearing

sa: स तथा रक्ष्यमाणो वै पार्थेनामिततेजसा। धृतवर्मा शरं दीप्त मुमोच विजये तदा॥
en: While, however, Partha of immeasurable energy fought mildly with him without wishing to kill him, Dhritavarman shot a burning arrow at him.

sa: सोऽयं द्यूतप्रवादेन श्रियः प्रत्यवरोपितः। तूष्णीमास्ते यथा मूढः स्वानि कर्माणि चिन्तयन्।।१४।
en: But deprived of fortune by rivalry of dice he now holds silence like a fool meditating over his own misdeeds.

sa: ततः संवत्सरे पूर्णे क्षयं यातानि सर्वशः॥ साधनानि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ततोऽहं भृशदुःखितः।
en: And when a year had been completed, my defensive resources were entirely exhausted, and at this, I was exceedingly aggrieved.

sa: ततस्तु नीलो बलवान्पर्यस्थापयन्बलम्। प्रविचिक्षेप शैलाग्रं कुम्भकर्णाय धीमते॥
en: Then the powerful Nīla, arranging his forces, discharged a mountain-peak at the intelligent Kumbhakarma.

sa: स तेन विजयस्तूर्णमासीद् विद्धः करे भृशम्। मुमोच गाण्डिवं मोहात् तत् पपाताथ भूतले॥
en: Deeply pierced in the hand by that arrow, Vijaya became stupefied and his bow Gandiva dropped down on the Earth from his relaxed grasp.

sa: मुखानि ऋतवो मासाः पादा द्वादश कीर्तिताः। ये तु वृक्षं निकृन्तन्ति मूषिकाः सततोत्थिताः॥ रात्र्यहानि तु तान्याहुर्भूतानां परिचिन्तकाः।
en: The rats and the snakes that are eating up the tree are the days and nights that are continually lessening the periods of life of all creatures. The bees are our desires.

sa: स पपात ततो भूमो वज्राहत इव द्रुमः। दुष्कर्णं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा पञ्च राजन् महारथाः॥
en: There at the latter fell down on the ground like a tree smitten by the thunder bolt. Beholding Dushkarna slain, the five mighty car-warrior, O king.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु जनकः प्रत्युवाच महामुनिम्। श्रूयतामस्य धनुषो यदर्थमिह तिष्ठति॥
en: Thus accosted, Janaka replied to the mighty Muni, saying, Lisen to why the bow lie here.

sa: सत्यवत्युवाच सद्यो यथा प्रपद्येते देव्यौ गर्भं तथा कुरु॥ अराजकेषु राष्ट्रेषु प्रजानाथा विनश्यति। नश्यन्ति च क्रियाः सर्वा नास्ति वृष्टिर्न देवता॥
en: Satyavati said : Take such steps as the ladies may conceive today. The people perish in a kingdom where there is anarchy. Sacrifices and other holy acts are destroyed, the rains and the celestial disappear from that place.

sa: वञ्चयित्वा तदा भीमं गदया कुरुसत्तमः॥ ताडयामास संक्रुद्धो वक्षोदेशे महाबलः।
en: Baffling Bhimasena thus, the highly powerful Kuru king, at last in anger struck the former in the chest.

sa: ततो मामब्रवीत् प्रीतस्तप आतिष्ठ भारत। तपस्वी नचिरेण त्वं द्रक्ष्यसे विबुधाधिपम्॥
en: And being pleased, he said to me "practice asceticism. By asceticism you will soon behold the lord of the gods.'

sa: युगपत् तं किरातस्तु विकृष्य बलवद्धनुः। अभ्याजने दृढतरं कम्पयत्रिव मे मनः॥
en: The hunter too, drawing his strong bow simultaneously (with me), wounded him more efficiently, as if making my mind tremble.

sa: नारायणे त्वेकमना वसामि सर्वेण भावेन शरीरभूता। तस्मिन् हि धर्मः सुमहान् निविष्टो ब्रह्मण्यता चात्र तथा प्रियत्वम्॥
en: I live, with a heart firm and unshaken, in Narayana, in my embodied self. In Him exists virtue, full and perfect, devotion to the Brahmanas, and the quality of goodness.

sa: हेमपुङ्खा महाराज व्यशोभन्त दिशो दश। अपिबन् सूतपुत्रस्य शोणितं रक्तभोजनाः॥
en: Those blood-drinking arrows decked with gold, then illumined the ten quaters and drank the life-blood of Suta's son.

sa: एतेन शतशो देवा दानवाश्च पराजिताः। रक्षितानि च रक्षांसि यक्षाश्चापि निषूदिताः॥
en: He has vanquished (in battle) hundreds of deities and Dänavas; and he has always) protected the Rakşasas, and destroyed Yakşas.

sa: अग्रतो देवदूतश्च ययौ राजा च पृष्ठतः। पन्थानमशुभं दुर्गं सेवितं पापकर्मभिः॥
en: The celestial messenger went first, followed by the king. The path was difficult and trodden by men of sinful deeds.

sa: अमी लक्ष्मण दृश्यन्ते चूताः कुसुमशालिनः। विभ्रमोत्सिक्तमनसः साङ्गरागा नरा इव ॥
en: There appear, O Laksmana, those blossoming mango trees like to persons, exercised with passion and smeared with unguents of sandal.

sa: स तु तेन प्रहारेण मातङ्ग इव रोहितः॥ हस्तिवद्धस्तिसंकाशमभिदुद्राव ते सुतम्।
en: Worked up with anger at that blow, Bhima then rushed at your son like an elephant rushing against an elephant.

sa: लाजैश्चैव तथा पुष्पैधूपैश्चैव सुगन्धिभिः। पूजयित्वा महाबाहू राघवः पुष्पकं तदा॥ गम्यतामिति चोवाच आगच्छ त्वं स्मरे यदा। सिद्धानां च गतौ सौम्य मा विषादेन योजया॥ प्रतिघातश्च ते मा भूद्यथेष्टं गच्छतो दिशः।
en: Having said this and worshipped it with dried paddy, fragrant flowers and incense, Rāma, having long arms, addressed Puspaka. "Do you go and come here whenever I shall remember you.
