While proceeding by the welkin, O gentle one, be not sorry for our separation. And be not röbstructed in your course while traversing all the quarters.

sa: ये व्यतीता महात्मानो राजानः सगरादयः॥ तेषामपीदृशं कर्म न कदाचन शुश्रुम।
en: We have not heard of such a feat having been done by even Sagara and other great kings of yore.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा रामः पुष्पकेण महाबलः। उवाच पुष्पकं दृष्ट्वा विमानं पुनरागतम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Pușpaka, the highly powerful Rāma said to the returning car stationed in the welkin:

sa: स तासां वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रकृतीनां नराधिपः। तं तत्याजाहितं पुत्रं तासां प्रियचिकीर्षया ॥
en: Hearing these words of his subjects, that lord of men, with the intention of doing good to them, forsook that mischievous son of his.

sa: ममापि परमा प्रीतिर्हते तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि। रावणे सगणे चैव सपुत्रे सहबान्धवे॥
en: I have greatly been delighted on the destruction of the vicious-souled Rāvana, with his relatives, sons and friends.

sa: यथा चैवाभवद् युद्धं तच्चाचक्ष्व पितामह। विस्तरेण महाबाहो परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: O grandfather, O you of mighty arms, tell me fully how the battle took place. Great is my curiosity to hear it.

sa: तस्मिन् मोहमनुप्राप्ते शरजालं महत् तदा। सैन्धवा मुमुचुस्तूर्णं गतसत्त्वे महारथे॥
en: When Dhananjaya became stupefied, the Saindhava warriors once more shot forthwith at that senseless warrior, numberless other arrOWS.

sa: तस्मिन् कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठे जानुभ्यामवनीं गते॥ उदतिष्ठत् ततो नादः संजयानां जगत्पते।
en: When that Kuru's hero fell upon his knees, a loud cry arose from among the Srinjayas, O king!

sa: ततः प्रलीने सर्वस्मिन् भूते स्थावरजङ्गमे। स्मृतिमन्तस्तदा धीरा न लीयन्ते कदाचन॥
en: Then, when all existent objects, mobile and immobile, become become dissolved, wise men possessed of a powerful memory never dissolve.

sa: स्थितोऽस्म्यद्य रणे जेतुं त्वां वै वीर स्थिरो भव। एवमुक्तस्तु राधेयो युद्धात् कर्णो न्यवर्तत॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the son of Radha, Karna, refrained from the fight, for the great car-warrior thought that the Brahma might is ever invincible. a

sa: ततः फलानि पत्राणि शाखाश्चापि मनोहराः। शुकस्य दृढभक्तित्वाच्छ्रीमतां प्राप स दुमः॥ शुकश्च कर्मणा तेन आनृशंस्यकृतेन वै। आयुषोऽन्ते महाराज प्राप शक्रसलोकताम्॥
en: Then that tree became revived and grand through the penanres of the parrot, and the latter, too, O great king, at the end of his life, acquired the companionship of Shakra by virtue of that act of mercy.

sa: तुष्टोऽस्मि तव कौन्तेय ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते। यत् ते मनोगतं वीर तद् ब्रूहि वितराम्यहम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, I am pleased (with you). Say what I shall do for you. Tell me, O hero, what is your wish. I will fulfill it.

sa: विशेषतस्तु पश्यामि वर्षे पञ्चदरोऽद्य वै॥ अस्य पापस्य शुद्ध्यर्थं नियतोऽस्मि सुदुर्मतिः।
en: Of wicked understanding as I am, now, after the lapse of fifteen years, I am trying to expiate my sins.

sa: गीतं नृत्यं विचित्रं च वादिनं विविधं तथा। शिक्षयिष्याम्यहं राजन् विराटस्य पुरस्त्रियः॥
en: O king, I shall instruct the ladies of Virata's house in singing, delightful dancing and also in musical performances of sundry sorts.

sa: सावमदं तु यद्वाक्यमथवा हितमुच्यते। नाभिनन्देत तद् राजा मानार्थी मानवर्जितम्॥
en: A respectable king dose not receive with good grace friendly words even when they are expressed disre .pectfully.

sa: तच्चातिकायं हि महत्प्रकाशं रक्षस्तदा तोयनिधौ पपात। ग्राहान्परान्मीनवरान्भुजंगमान् ममर्द भूमिं च तथा विवेश ॥
en: Then that Rākşasa of gigantic proportions and vast to the view plunged into the deep; and crushing huge and mighty fishes and serpents, saught the depths.

sa: गृहाद् गृहं राक्षसानामुद्यानानि च वानरः। वीक्षमाणो ह्यसंत्रस्तः प्रासादांश्च चचार सः॥
en: And that monkey with a calm mind, eyeing (all round), ranged one house from another, and gardens, and stately piles.

sa: यच्चापि तीर्थानि चरन्नगच्छं द्वारकां प्रति। तत्राहमपि ते भक्तिमर्जुनं प्रति दृष्टवान्॥
en: When, returning from a sojourn to all the sacred places, I went to Dvaraka, I saw your reverence for Arjuna.

sa: एकराशौ समेष्यन्ति प्रपत्स्यति तदा कृतम्। कालवर्षी च पर्जन्यो नक्षत्राणि शुभानि च॥
en: Will with the constellation of Pushya enter the same, the clouds will incessantly shower rains and stars and planets will be auspicious.

sa: तं छिन्नबाहुं समवेक्ष्य रामः समापतन्तं सहसा नदन्तम्। द्वावर्धचन्द्रौ निशितौ प्रगृह्य चिच्छेद पादौ युधि राक्षसस्य॥
en: Rāma, seeing that one shorn of his arms suddenly spring up, roaring, took up two whetted crescents, and in the contest cut off the legs of the Rākşasa.

sa: स तां दृष्ट्वा च्युतां धैर्याद् ब्राह्मया लक्ष्म्या विवर्जिताम्। धिकछब्देन महातेजा गर्हयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: Having seen her deprived of the lustre of chastity and full of giddiness, that greatly effulgent and mighty Rishi reproached her by crying “fie".

sa: किं नु दुःखतरं शक्यं मया द्रष्टुमतः परम्। योऽहमद्य नरव्याघ्रान् सुप्तान् पश्यामि भूतले॥
en: What more painful sight shall I ever see than what I see (now) the best of men (the Pandavas) sleeping on the (bare) ground!

sa: ततो ज्येष्ठो जामदग्न्यो रुमण्वान् नाम नामतः। आजगाम सुषेणश्च वसुर्विश्वावसुस्तथा॥
en: There came then the eldest of Jamadagni's son, named Rumanvan and then Sushena, then Vasu and then Vishvavasu.

sa: श्रुताश्च बहवोऽस्माभी राजानो ये दिवं गताः। दत्त्वेमां पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाविधि॥
en: We have heard of numerous monarchs who attained to heaven having duly given away this earth as a gift to the Brahmanas.

sa: तव निगुर्णतां ज्ञात्वा पक्षपातं सुतेषु च। द्वैधीभावं तथा धर्मे पाण्डवेषु च मत्सरम्॥५ तव जिह्ममभिप्रायं विदित्वा पाण्डवान् प्रति। आप्रिलापांश्च बहून् मनुजाधिपसत्तम॥
en: Knowing your worthlessness, your partiality for your sons, your duplicity in virtue, your animosity against the sons of Pandu and ascertaining your crooked intentions against them and listening to many of your incoherent and delirious bewailings, 0 foremost of kings.

sa: क्व ते महारथाः सर्वे शार्दूलसमविक्रमाः। तैरप्ययं जितो लोकः कच्चित् पुरुषसत्तमैः॥
en: Where are those great car-warriors who possessed of the prowess of tigers? Have those foremost of men gained this region?

sa: ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामिनम्। विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः।।१९।
en: And having permitted the charming chariot coursing at will to go away he said: Do you now go; may good betide you.

sa: वर्तमानः सुखे दुःखं यथाहं प्रापितस्त्वया। तथा त्वां च सुखं प्राप्तं दुःखमभ्यागमिष्यति॥
en: As I have been plunged into grief when I was happy, so you will also be afflicted with grief when in happiness.

sa: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते। हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते॥
en: He who has no egoism, and whose mind is not sullied, does not kill, or fettered by action, if he kills all these people.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच यत् तत् तदा महद् ब्रह्मल्लँलोमशो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। इन्द्रस्य वचनादेव पाण्डुपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ यच्चापि ते भयं तीव्र न च कीर्तयसे क्वचित्। तच्चाप्यपहरिष्यामि धनंजय इतो गते॥ किं न तज्जपतां श्रेष्ठ कर्णं प्रति महद् भयम्। आसीन्न च स धर्मात्मा कथयामास कस्यचित्।।३।
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, (you say) at that time, Lomasha conveyed to Yudhishthira, the son Pandu, a message from Indra in these words of grave consequence, “I will remove that great terror which you do not reveal to any one when Dhananjaya departs from this place," now tell me, O best of devotees, what this great fear was which Yudhishthira entertained in respect of Karna and why he did not reveal it to any one.

sa: तमप्रतिबलं दृष्ट्वा विषण्णवदनास्तु ताः॥ अशक्योऽयं विचन्त्यैवं तमेव शरणं ययुः। ऊचुश्चैनं त्वमस्माकं पुत्रो भव महाबल॥
en: But seeing him matchlessly powerful, they became dispirited. Considering him to be invincible, they sought his protection and said to him, "O greatly powerful one, become our son.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच अशोच्यत्वं कुतस्तस्य यस्या भर्ता युधिष्ठिरः। जानन् सर्वाणि दुःखानि किं मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: Draupadi said Whence can there be a freedom of grief to her who has Yudhishthira for her husband? Knowing all my griefs do you ask me?

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स्कन्दं श्रुत्वा तदा देवा वासवं सहिताऽब्रुवन्॥ अविषाबलं स्कन्दं जहि शक्राशु माचिरम्। यदि वा न निहंस्येनं देवेन्द्रोऽयं भविष्यति॥ त्रैलोक्यं संनिगृह्यास्मांस्त्वां च शक्र महाबल।
en: Hearing of Skanda, the celestial then all spoke thus to Vasava (Indra), "O Shakra, soon kill Skanda, for his prowess is unbearable. If you do not destroy him, he will conquer us with all the three worlds. Vanquishing you, he will become the mighty lord of the celestial.

sa: न त्वं कामं समाधेया भर्तृशुश्रूषणं प्रति। अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम्॥
en: Though there is no necessity for giving you any instruction as regards your duty towards your husband-still I should say that he is your great god.

sa: त्वरायुक्तौ महाराज प्रार्थयानौ महद् यशः। अर्जुनस्य वधप्रेप्सू पुत्रार्थ तव धन्विनौ॥
en: With great agility, O mighty monarch, desirous of winning great fame and slaying Arjuna and doing good to your son,

sa: तस्मिन् हते राजपुत्रे पञ्चालानां यशस्करे। हत द्रोणं हत द्रोणमित्यासीनिःस्वनो महान्॥
en: Upon the death of that renouned prince of the Panchalas, loud cries of kill Drona, kill Drona were herd there.

sa: भजस्व मां वरारोहे पतित्वे वरवर्णिनि। एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी नहुषेण पतिव्रता॥
en: o you with slender waist, O you with bright complexion, choose your husband." The chaste goddess being thus spoken to by Nahusha.

sa: ते निवृत्ताः पुनः पार्थं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्। रणे सपनान् निघ्नन्तं जिगीषन्तं परान् युधि॥
en: But soon turning back, they surrounded Partha on all sides, who was slaying his foes in battle and trying to obtain victory over them.

sa: ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्दशभिः शिनिपुङ्गवः। जघान सूतं चाश्वांश्च ध्वजं च कृतवर्मणः॥
en: With ten keen arrows that Shini chief then struck the driver, the horses and the standard of Kritavarman.

sa: वयं ब्रूमो न धर्मात्मन् व्येतु ते भयमीदृशम्। उपतिष्ठतु कल्याणं भवन्तं भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: We have not, O you righteous soul, said anything of the kind. Drive away your anxiety. May prosperity be with you and your brothers.

sa: तस्य भीमो धनुश्छित्त्वा ध्वजं च दशभिः शरैः। विव्याध कौरवश्रेष्ठं नवत्या नवपर्वणाम्॥
en: But Bhima, cutting off his bow and his standard with sharpened arrows, pierced the lord of the Kauravas with nine straight darts.

sa: विवेश वसुधां भित्त्वा सुरास्तत्र विसिस्मियुः॥ कर्ण तु सर्वभूतानि पूजयामासुरञ्जसा।
en: Entered the earth, piercing through her bowels, thereby filling the gods with wonder. Then all creatures applauded Karna.

sa: पाण्डवाः सहपञ्चाला योधाश्चान्ये नृपोत्तमाः। प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त तयोघरि समागमे॥
en: The Pandavas, the Panchalas and the other warriors, witnessed that terrible encounter between the two heroes.

sa: गदप्रद्युम्नसाम्बाश्च चारुदेष्णश्च वीर्यवान्। उल्मुको निशद्दश्चैव वीरश्चाङ्गावहस्तथा॥
en: Gada, Pradyumna, Samba, the greatly energetic Charudeshna Ulmuka, Nishatha, the brave Angavaha.

sa: अथ सप्तर्षयः श्रुत्वा जातं पुत्रं महौजसम्। तत्यजुः षट् तदा पत्नीविना देवीमरुन्धतीम्॥
en: The seven Rishis, hearing that a greatly powerful son was born (to them), abandoned their six wives except the adorable lady Arundhuti.

sa: प्रत्याश्वस्तस्तु बीभत्सुः शनकैरिव भारत। प्रेतराजपुरं प्राप्य पुनः प्रत्यागतो यथा॥१९
en: Then, O Bharata, recovering slowly, like one coming back from a visit to the regions of Death, Vibhatsu.

sa: व महर्षिः स चैवाग्र्यः साप्सराः क्व च मेनका। क्व च त्वमेवं कृपणा तापसीवेषधारिणी॥
en: Where is now that best of great Rishis (Vishvamitra) and that best of Apsaras Menaka? And where are you, (though) in the humble garb of ascetics.

sa: अयं तु पुरुषो बालः शिशुपालो न बुध्यते। सर्वत्र सर्वदा कृष्णं तस्मादेवं प्रभाषते॥
en: This Shishupala is a mere child. He does not know who Krishna is, and therefore every where and always he speaks of Krishna thus.

sa: स्मयन्नेव तु तान् वीरान् द्रोणः प्रत्यग्रहीत् स्वयम्। अतीथीनागतान् यद्वत् सलिलेनासनेन च॥
en: Then Drona received all those heroes smilingly, even as a host receives his welcome guest with water and the offer of seats.

sa: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य चुकोप सौमित्रिरमित्रहन्ता। अमृष्यमाणश्च समुत्पपात जग्राह चापं च ततः स्मयित्वा ॥
en: Hearing his speech, that slayer of foesSumitrā's son, was fired with wrath. And not bearing him, he sprang forward disregarding his antagonist's words, and took up his bow.

sa: अविमृश्यैव च ततः कृतवानस्मि तत् तथा। तेनोच्छिष्टेन गात्राणि शिरश्चैवाभ्यमक्षयम्॥
en: Unhesitatingly I did as directed. Indeed, with the residuc of that frumenty I smeared my body and head.

sa: य इदं सर्वमादत्ते तस्माच्छक स्थिरो भव। मया त्वया च पूर्वेश्च न स शक्योऽतिवर्तितुम्॥
en: Time carries away all things. Therefore, O Indra, do not brag! Time cannot be quieted by either you or me or by those gone before us.

sa: वासुदेवे स्थिते चापि द्रोणपुत्रं प्रशंससि। यः कलां षोडशी पूर्णां धनंजय न तेऽर्हति॥
en: When Vasudeva himself is here, praise you the son of Drona, who, ODhananjaya, is not a match for even a sixteenth part of yourself?

sa: अत्र नारायणः कृष्णो जिष्णुश्चैव नरोत्तमः। बदर्यामाश्रमपदे तथा ब्रह्मा च शाश्वतः॥
en: Here lives Narayana, the ever victorious Krishna, that best among men in the hermitage of Badri and so does Brahma.

sa: प्रिये हि तव वर्तते भ्रातरौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ। तयोः प्रिये स्थितं चैव विद्धि मां राजपुङ्गव॥
en: The brothers Krishna and Arjuna are ever engaged in achieving your good; O best of all kings, know me also to be devoted to your welfare.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो द्रोणं दृष्ट्वाऽन्तिकमुपागतम्। महता शरवर्षेण प्रत्यगृह्णादभीतवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing Yudhishthira approach him, Drona received him with a continuous downpour of arrows, like one undaunted.

sa: स च भूमिधरः श्रीमान् बलिना तेन पीडितः। सवृक्षशिखरोदनः प्रविवेश रसातलम्॥
en: And that graceful mountain also, tormented by that powerful one, entered the nether regions with its tall trees and summits.

sa: तस्मिन्काले स धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणो राममब्रवीत्। कुम्भकर्णवधे युक्तो योगान्परिमृशन्बहून्॥
en: Intent on finishing Kumbhakarņa, the virtuous Laksmana, revolving many a means, (at last) spoke to Rāma.

sa: त्वं न स्रष्टा च भर्ता च हर्ता च जगतः प्रभो। त्वया सृष्टमिदं विश्वं यच्चेङ्गं यच् नेङ्गति॥
en: “O lord, you are the creator, the protector and the destroyer of the universe as well as of ourselves. It is you who have created this universe with all its mobile creatures.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु त्वरमाणं महारथाः। विव्यधुः सायकैर्गाढं कृतवर्माणमाहवे॥
en: Meanwhile many mighty car-warriors, making haste began to pierce Kritavarman deeply and quickly with their arrows.

sa: ततो विलोक्य तेजस्वी ब्राह्मणो मामुवाच ह। जितः क्रोधस्त्वया कृष्ण प्रकृत्यैव महाभुज॥
en: Gifted with great energy, the Brahmana, seeing me, said, O mightyarmed Krishna, you have subdued anger by the strength of your nature.

sa: आरुरोह रथं चापि पाञ्चाल्यस्य महात्मनः। जनमेजयस्य समरे त्वरायुक्ते महारथः॥
en: (And) that great car-warrior in that battle, with great haste mounted the car of Janamejaya, the high-souled Panchalas.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः समरे हार्दिक्येन स्म पाण्डवाः। इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तो नैव चक्रुतिं रणे॥
en: Thus slaughtered by Hridika's son in battle, the Pandavas began to run hither and thither and they could not then fight steadily.

sa: हारालंकारयोग्यौ तु स्तनौ चोभौ सुशोभनौ। सुजातौ सहितौ लक्ष्म्या पीनौ वृत्तौ निर गै॥
en: Both your breasts exceedingly graceful, well-shaped, endued with beauty, well rounded and without a space between, and are worthy of being decked with garlands.

sa: वृद्धानामिव सत्त्वानां मनो भवति विह्वलम्। मनुष्याणां महाराज यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sin is not restrained, the minds of men, O king, become weak and bewildered like those of persons wounded with weapons.

sa: सा तस्य गर्जितं श्रुत्वा राक्षसानां महाचमूः॥ प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे मृत्युपाशावपाशिता।
en: Entangled in the noose of death, that mighty army of the Rākşasas hearing his challenge, experienced boundless enthusiasm.

sa: द्रवमाणं तु तत् सैन्यं द्रोणकर्णी महारथौ। जघ्नतुः पृष्ठतो राजन् किरन्तौ सायकान् बहून्॥
en: And as the army of the Pandavas was routed, the mighty warriors Karna and Drona, O king, pursued them from behind discharging numerous arrows.

sa: सदा द्विजातीन् सम्पूज्य किं फलं तत्र मानद। एतद् ब्रूहि स्फुटं सर्वे सुमहान् संशयोऽत्र मे॥
en: O giver of honours, what rewards are gained by constantly adoring the Brahmanas? Kindly explain this clearly to me, for my mind is disturbed by doubts about this.

sa: दुर्योधनपुरोगाश्च भ्रातरः सर्व एव ते। गान्धारराजः सुबलः शकुनिश्च महाबलः॥
en: All the (Kuru) brothers with Duryodhana at their head, the king of Gandharva Subala, the greatly strong Shakuni.

sa: स सर्वाः समतिक्रम्य कक्ष्या दशरथात्मजः। संनिवर्त्य जनं सर्वं शुद्धान्तःपुरमत्यगात्॥
en: And in this way passing by all, and ordering his followers to go back, entered the inner apartment.

sa: बलैस्तु संकुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः। मां नयेद् यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत् तस्य सदृशं भवेत्॥
en: But if blocking up Lankā with his forces, that afflictor of enemies, Kākutstha, take me (from hence), then that shall be worthy of him.

sa: कृपः शारद्वतो राजन् मागधाश्च तरस्विनः। सात्वतः कृतवर्मा च दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रिताः॥
en: O king, Saradvata's son Kripa, the highly active Magadhas and Kritavarma of the Satvata race stood at the right wing.

sa: यो घृतार्थी खरीक्षीरं मथेद् गन्धर्वसत्तम। विष्ठां तत्रानुपश्येत न मण्डं न च वै घृतम्॥
en: If a person seeking butter churns the milk of the she-ass, without finding what he seeks he simply finds a substance of foul smell like ordure.

sa: आयसानि च चक्राणि भुशुण्ड्यः शक्तितोमराः॥ पतन्त्यविरलाः शूलाः शतघ्यः पट्टिशास्तथा।
en: Iron wheels, Bhusundis, javelins, lances and spears and Shataghnis and battle axes, then began to fall in torrents.

sa: घटोत्कचप्रयुक्तेन सिंहनादेन भीषिताः॥ प्रसुवुर्गजा मूत्रं विव्यथुश्च नरा भृशम्।
en: Frightened at the war-cries uttered by Ghatotkacha the elephants discharged urine and men were sorely afflicted.

sa: रामे मयात्र निहते येऽन्ये स्थास्यन्ति संयुगे। तानहं योधयिष्यामि स्वबलेन प्रमाथिना॥
en: On Rāma being here slain by me, the rest remaining in the encounter-them shall I undertake with my all-crushing vigour.

sa: ततो मामाह भगवानास्यं स्वं विवृतं कुरु। विवृतं च ततो मेऽऽस्यं प्रविष्टा च सरस्वती॥
en: The god then ordered me to open my mouth. I did as I was cominanded. The goddess Sarasvati then entered into my body, O sinless one.

sa: संजय उवाच न तत्र पाण्डवा गृद्धाः शृणु राजन् वचो मम। गृद्धो दुर्योधनस्तत्र शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, hear my words. The Pandavas are not covetous about this country. It is Duryodhana who is covetous. It is the son of Subala, Shakuni.

sa: ततो हरीणां तदनीकमुग्रं दुद्राव शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य। तस्थि स तस्यापततः पुरस्तान्महीधराग्रं हनुमान्प्रगृह्य ॥
en: Then grasping his sharpened spear, Kumbhakarņa darted against that terrific array of monkeys. And as he charged them, Hanuman armed with a mountain-peak, stood before him.

sa: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे पितुरन्तिकं तदा जनः स सर्वो मुदितो नृपात्मजे। प्रतीक्षते तस्य पुनः स्म निर्गमं यथोदयं चन्द्रमसः सरित्पतिः॥
en: That son of the king entering into the presence of his father, all were extremely gladdened and were eagerly expecting his return like to the lord of water expecting the appearance of the moon.

sa: सर्पसत्रे वर्तमाने पावको वः प्रधक्ष्यति। जनमेजयस्य राजर्षेः पाण्डवेयस्य धीमतः॥
en: "In the Snake-sacrifice of the royal sage, wise Janamejaya of the Pandava race Agni will consume you all.

sa: व्याकुलकृतमत्यर्थं पश्य सैन्यं किरीटिना। नानामृगसहस्राणां यूथं केसरिणा यथाय॥
en: Behold, the army has been greatly assailed by Kiritin as various animals are by a lion.

sa: उभे संध्ये प्रकाशन्ते दिशां दाहसमन्विते। पर्जन्यः पांसुवर्षी च मांसवर्षी च भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, in both the twilights, the four quarters appear to be ablaze. The clouds pour down dust and flesh.

sa: ततस्ते पाण्डवाः सर्वे प्रत्यागमनकाक्षिणः। प्रतीक्षन्तः कियत्कालं जितात्मानोऽवतस्थिरे॥
en: Thereupon all the self-controlled Pandavas, awaiting their arrival, remained in expectation for some time.

sa: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैकृतिकोऽलसः। विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते॥
en: Tama Agent is he who is void of application, who is without discernment, who is obstinate, deceitful malicious, idle, desponding, and procrastinating.

sa: मैत्रेय उवाच असंशयं महाप्राज्ञ यथैवात्थ तथैव तत्। अनुज्ञातश्च भवता किंचिद् ब्रूयामहं विभो॥
en: Maitreya said O you of great wisdom, it is what you have said O powerful one, with your permission I wish to say something.

sa: अन्तकाले हि संवासं यया गन्तासि कान्तया। प्रेतराजपुरं प्राप्तं सर्वभूतदुरत्ययम्। भक्त्या मतिमतां श्रेष्ठ सैव त्वानुगमिष्यति॥
en: Your wife with whom you will join at your last moments will also go with you with reverence and affection to the ever unavoidable land of the dead.

sa: सूर्यवर्मा ततः पार्थे शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। शतान्यमुञ्चद् राजेन्द्र लध्वस्त्रमभिदर्शयन्॥
en: Then Suryavarman, showing great lightness of hand, pierced Dhananjaya with hundreds of straight arrows, O king!

sa: परां सिद्धिमवाप्नोति सावित्री ह्युत्तमां पठन्॥ न च राजभयं तेषां न पिशाचान्न राक्षसात्।
en: There children do not die, nor snakes live. Indeed, at such places, there can be no fear of the king, nor Pishachas and Rakshasas.

sa: यस्तु तं विषयं गच्छेन्मन्त्रो वर्णः स्वरोऽपि वा। तन्मनो जगमो नाम तस्मादसि गरीयसी॥
en: That mind is indeed called movable which, in the form of Mantra, letter, or voice, is referrible to your dominion. Hence, you are superior.

sa: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव देवलश्च महातपाः। विश्वावसुस्तुम्बुस्च चित्रसेनश्च भारत॥
en: They were Narada, Parvata, Devala of austere penances, Vishvavasu, Tunburu and Chitrasena, O Bharata.

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच अनुत्पन्नेषु वाक्येषु चोद्यमाना विवक्षया। किनु पूर्वं तदा देवी व्याजहार सरस्वती॥
en: What did the goddess of Word then say, formerly when, though moved by the wish to speak, speech could not come out?

sa: अथ तौ भगवान् प्राह प्रहृष्टश्च्यवनस्तदा। न वृथा व्याहृतं पूर्वं यन्मया तद् भविष्यति॥
en: Pleased with their conduct, the illustrious Chyavana said to them I have never before spoken falsehood; It must, therefore be as I have said.

sa: यमस्य पुरुषैः क्लेशं यमस्य पुरुषैर्वधम्। दुःखं संसारचक्रं च नरः क्लेशं स विन्दति॥
en: After birth individual soul receives woe and death from the messengers of Yama. Indeed, he goes through misery and a painful round of rebirth.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। नातदस्य च संवादमृर्देवमतस्य च॥
en: The Brahmana said Regarding it is cited the ancient discourse between Narada and the Rishi Devamata.

sa: एष राजन्नीदृशो वै ब्राह्मणः कश्यपोऽभवत्। अन्यं प्रब्रहि वा त्वं च कश्यपात् क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: Kashyapa is a Brahmana. This was the feet, O king, that a Brahmana did, teil mc the name of the Kshatriya who is superior to Kashyapa.

sa: स्वात्यामथ धनं दत्त्वा यदिष्टतममात्मनः। प्राप्नोति लोकान् स शुभानिह चैव महद् यशः॥
en: By making gifts of riches under the constellation Svati, one acquires such excellent regions as one desires and wins, besides great fame.

sa: स्त्रियं हि यः प्रार्थयते संनिकर्ष च गच्छति। ईषच्च कुरुते सेवां तमेवेच्छन्ति योषितः॥
en: Women show a liking for those men who court them, who approach their presence and who respectfully serve them to even a slight extent.

sa: क्षुधा निर्मुदति प्रज्ञां धर्मबुद्धिं व्यपोहति॥ क्षुधापरिगतज्ञानो धृतिं त्यजति चैव ह।
en: Hunger destroys one's wisdom and drives off one's righteous understanding. One whose intelligence is overwhelmed by hunger renounces all fortitude.

sa: ददौ कुन्ती ततस्ताभ्यां रत्नानि विविधानि च॥ द्रौपदी च सुभद्रा च याश्चाप्यन्याऽददुः स्त्रियः।
en: Kunti gave them many gems and costly things. Draupadi and Subha 'ra and the other ladies of Kuru's race all made presents to them.

sa: सत्ये धर्मे च निरतस्तस्य शक्र फलं शृणु। गोसहस्रेण समिता तस्य धेनुर्भवत्युत॥
en: Hear, O Shakra, of the fruits which truthful persons enjoy. If such a person gives away a single cow, that becomes thousandfold.

sa: ध्रुवं श्रेयः परं तात भविष्यति तवोत्तमम्। यस्य ते पुरुषव्याघ्रः सखा चायं जनार्दनः॥
en: O son, Forsooth, high and great benefits will be reaped by you who have that foremost of all persons, viz., Vasudeva, for your friend.

sa: अश्विभ्यां सह सोमं च पिबाम विगतज्वराः। ततः स प्रणतः शक्रश्चकार च्यवनस्य तत्॥
en: We shall without any hesitation drink Soma with the Ashvins in our company. Then bowing down his head to Chyavana, Shakra obeyed his command.

sa: आशंसन्ते हि पितरः सुवृष्टिमिव कर्षकाः। अस्माकमपि पुत्रो वा पौत्रे वान्नं प्रदास्यति॥
en: Like cultivators expecting auspicious showers of rain, the departed manes always expect that their sons and grandsons would present food to them.

sa: गौरं श्यामं च कृष्णं च वर्णं विकुरुते पुनः॥ विरूपो रूपवांश्चैव युवा वृद्धस्तथैव च।
en: Sometimes he becomes fair, sometimes darkish, sometimes dark of complexion. Sometimes he becomes ugly and sometimes beautiful. Sometimes he appears as young and sometimes as old.

sa: स तानुवाच धर्मात्मा बीभत्सुरपराजिताः॥ युधिष्ठिरस्य वचनं न च ते जगृहुर्हितम्।
en: The unvanquished Bibhatsu of virtuous soul addressed them peacefully, but they were reluctant to accept the beneficial words of Yudhishthira.

sa: द्वितीयं त्वद्धतमिदं त्वत्तेजः कृतमद्य वै। दृष्ट्वा च विस्मिताः कृष्ण सा च नः स्मृतिरागता।॥
en: Sometime before, Mahadeva burnt Himavat with his energy. You have shown us a similar wonderful spectacle. Indeed, we remember that by what we have seen today.

sa: न चैबोत्सहते स्थातुं कश्चिदने महात्मनः। न हि भूतं समं तेन त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते॥
en: There is no one who is capable of attending before the great Being. Indeed, there is no Being in the three worlds who is his equal.

sa: यत्तच्छृणु महाबाहो निखिलेन धनंजय। महाभारतयुद्धे यत् त्वया शान्तनवो नृपः॥ अधर्मेण हतः पार्थ तस्यैषा निष्कृतिः कृता। न हि भीष्मस्त्वया वीर युद्ध्यमानो हि पातितः॥
en: O mighty-armed Dhananjaya, Hear all that I have done. In the great battle of the BharataPrinces, you had killed the royal son of Shantanu by unfair ways. What I have done has expiated your sin. You did not overthrow Bhishma while fighting with you!

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच इमे वै मानवा लोके स्त्रीषु सज्जन्त्यभीक्ष्णशः। मोहेन परमाविष्टा देवसृष्टेन पार्थिव॥
en: Yudhishthira said Overcome by the illusion of the divine Being, all men, O king in this world, are seen to attach themselves to women.

sa: वदन्त्यग्निं महादेवं तथा स्थाणुं महेश्वरम्। एकाक्षं त्र्यम्बकं चैव विश्वरूपं शिवं तथा॥
en: The Rishis describe Mahadeva as Agni, and Sthanu, and Maheshvara; as oneeyed, and threeeyed, of universal form, and Shiva or highly auspicious.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तिलानां कीदृशं दानमथ दीपस्य चैव हि। अन्नानां वाससां चैव भूय एव ब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Yudhishthira said Do you describe to me once again. O grandfather, the merit's of the gifts of sesame and of lamps for lighting darkness, as also of food and clothes.

sa: ऋषिरेष महानात्मा पुराणः शाश्वतोऽक्षरः। नैनं शक्तो हि संग्रामे जेतुं शक्तोऽपि पुत्रक॥
en: He is a Rishi, of powerful soul, eternal and indestructible. O dear son, Shakra himself is incapable of defeating him in battle.

sa: मया तु मोहनी नाम मायैषा सम्प्रदर्शिता। प्रियार्थं पुरुषेन्द्रस्य पितुस्तेऽद्य यशस्विनः॥
en: I have exhibited this illusion, deceiving your senses, for the benefit of this foremost of men, viz., your illustrious father.

sa: ज्ञेयास्तूग्राश्च सौम्याश्च तेजस्विन्यश्च ताः पृथक्। ओषध्यो बहुवीर्या हि बहुरूपास्तथैव च।॥
en: The (deciduous) herbs are of various kinds and possess different qualities. They should be classed as fierce, mild, and powerful.

sa: जमदग्निरुवाच साक्षाद् दृष्टोऽसि मे क्रोध गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः। न त्वयापकृतं मेऽद्य न च मे पन्युरस्ति वै॥
en: I have seen you, O Anger, in your embodied form. Go you wherever you like, without any anxiety. You have not done me any injury today. I have no grudge against you.

sa: एवमेतत् तदा वृत्ते यज्ञे तस्य महात्मनः। पश्यतां चापि नस्तत्र नकुलोऽन्तर्हितस्तदा॥
en: This is what took place in the sacrifice of that great king. The mungoose disappeared there in out very presence.

sa: शुभं वा यच्च कुर्वन्ति प्रजा राज्ञा सुरक्षिताः। चतुर्थं तस्य पुण्यस्य राजा चाप्नोति भारत॥
en: That king, O Bharata, O Bharata, who affords protection to his subjects gets fourth part of whatever merits his subjects win by living under his protection.

sa: दश चोभयतः पुत्रो मातापित्रोः पितामहान्। दधाति सुकृतान् लोकान् पुनाति च कुलं नरः॥
en: Such a man causes both his paternal and maternal ancestors to the tenth degree acquire regions of great happiness, and sanctifies his whole race.

sa: पवित्रमग्र्यं जगतः प्रतिष्ठा दिवौकसां मातरोऽथाप्रमेयाः। अन्वालभेद् दक्षिणतो व्रजेच्च दद्याच्च पात्रे प्रसमीक्ष्य कालम्॥
en: When going on journeys, one should leave the kine to his left. Determining the proper time, they should be given away to worthy persons.

sa: अपरे स्तम्भिनो नित्यं मानिनः पापतो रताः। आसनार्हस्य ये पीठं न प्रयच्छन्त्यचेतसः॥
en: There are others who are arrogant and proud for the possession of riches. Those senseless wretches never offer seats to worthy persons.

sa: पूर्वमासन्नशृङ्गा वै गाव इत्यनुशुश्रुमा शृङ्गार्थे समुपासन्त ताः किल प्रभुमव्ययम्॥
en: Formerly kine were hornless as we have heard. For getting horns they adored the eternal and powerful Brahman.

sa: ये केचिज्जन्तवो लोके जङ्गमाः स्थावराश्च ह। तेषां मामन्तकं विद्धि दारूणामिव पावकम्॥
en: I am the destroyer of all crcatures that exist in the world, mobile or immobile, as fire destroys all kinds of wood.

sa: गौ उवाच कासि देवि कुतो वा त्वं रूपेणाप्रतिभा भुवि। विस्मिताः स्म महाभागे तव रूपस्य सम्पदा॥
en: The kine said Who are you, O goddess? Whence have you become nonpareil on Earth for beauty? O highly blessed goddess, we have been filled with wonder at your beauty.

sa: हयांश्चास्य महाकायान् महावेगानरिंदम। चकार राजन् निर्जीवान् प्रहसन्निव पाण्डवः॥
en: The son of Pandu, laughing, next killed the king's horses of large size and great speed.

sa: अहो धिगिति राजा तु विक्रुश्य भृशदुःखितः॥ ऊर्ध्वबाहुः स्मरन् मातुः प्ररुरोद युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनपुरोगाश्च भ्रातरः सर्व एव ते॥
en: 'O Fie', cried king Yudhishthira in great agony, raising his arms a loft. Thinking of his mother, he wept like a child. All is brothers too, headed by Bhimasena, old the same.

sa: देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च भूतेभ्योऽतिथिभिः सह। इत्यर्थे सर्व एवेति समारम्भा भवन्ति वै॥
en: All these acts of mine are for the sake of the celestials, the departed manes, the Bhuttas, together with guests.

sa: इच्छामि चापि युष्मासु वस्तुं सर्वासु नित्यदा। आगत्य प्रार्थ ये युष्माञ्छ्रीजुष्टा भवताऽथ वै॥
en: I wish to always live in every one of you. Going to your presence, I solicit you. Be all of you gifted with Shree.

sa: एवं स निधनं प्राप्तः कुरुराजो महामनाः॥ गान्धारी च पृथा चैव जनन्यौ ते विशाम्पते।
en: Thus the great Kuru king met with his death, and it was thus that Gandhari and Kunti, your two others, also met with death, O monarch.

sa: प्रतिबिम्बमिवादशे गुरुपल्याः शरीरगम्। स तं घोरेण तपसा युक्तं दृष्ट्वा पुरन्दरः॥
en: Seeing the ascetic gifted with the terrible power of penances, Purandara, O king, fearing the Rishi's curse, trembled in fear.

sa: यद्ययन्मुञ्चति गात्रं हि स शान्तनुसुतस्तदा। तत् तद् विशल्यं भवति योगयुक्तस्य तस्य वै॥
en: In the midst of those great persons, including those great Rishis headed by Vyasa, the sight seemed to be a strange one, O king.

sa: अश्मसारमयं नूनं हृदयं मम पार्थिवाः॥ अपश्यन्त्याः प्रियं पुत्रं यन्न दीर्यति मेऽद्य वै।
en: You kings, forsooth, my heart is made of adamant, for it does not break even at the disappearance of that son from my view.

sa: इदं तु याचे नृपते त्वामहं शिरसा नतः। क्रियतां तावदाहारस्ततो गच्छाश्रमं प्रति॥
en: This, however, O king, I beg of you by bending my head. Do you first eat and afterwards go to your forest-retreat.

sa: प्रददौ तस्य महतो हिरण्यस्य महाद्युतिः॥ श्वशुरात् प्रीतिदायं तं प्राप्य सा प्रीतमानसा।
en: Receiving that gift of affection from her father-in-law, Pritha became pleased and devoted it to the performance of various acts of merit.

sa: ततः प्रोवाच ब्रह्मा तं शक्रं बलनिषूदनम्। अवज्ञातास्त्वया नित्यं गावो बलनिषूदन॥
en: Thus addressed by Indra, Brahman said to the destroyer of Bala, You have always, O destroyer of Bala, disregarded kine.

sa: तपस्वी कश्चिदभवत् सुवर्णो नाम भारत। वर्णतो हेमवर्णः स सुवर्ण इति पप्रथे॥
en: These was formerly an ascetic, O Bharata named Suvarna. His complexion was like that of gold and hence he was called Suvarna.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तच्छुत्वा वचनं शक्रो विपुलस्य महात्मनः। अकिंचिदुक्त्वा व्रीडार्तस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of the great Vipula, Shakra without saying anything, and covered with shame, disappeared.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा कौरव्यो रोषाद् गाण्डीवभृत् तदा॥ ततोऽथ वचनं स्मृत्वा भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य भारत।
en: The holder of Gandiva, having said these words in anger, recollected, however, the words, O Bharata, of his eldest brother.

sa: तस्मादन्नं परं लोके सर्वलोकेषु कथ्यते। अन्नाद् बलं च तेजश्च प्राणिनां वर्धते सदा॥
en: Therefore, food is considered as a very superior object in all the worlds. From food the strength and energy of living creatures continually increase.

sa: कर्मणा येन मुच्येयमस्मात् क्रूरादरिंदम॥ कर्मणा तद् विधत्स्वेह येन शुध्यति मे मनः।
en: Do you, O Janardana, so ordain that I may be feed from this heinous sin and that iny mind may be purified.

sa: अलंकारमथो भोज्यमत ऊर्ध्वं समाचरेः॥ पश्येथाश्च ततो योधान् सदा त्वं प्रतिहर्षयन्।
en: You should next supervise your arms, pleasing them on every occasion. You should devote your evenings to envoys and spies.

sa: वियुलस्य गुरौ वृत्तिं भक्तिमात्मनि तत्प्रभुः। धर्म च स्थिरतां दृष्ट्वा साधु साध्वित्यभाषत।॥
en: Observing Vipula's conduct towards himself his preceptor and his devotion also and marking his steadiness in virtue, the powerful Devasharman exclaimed-Excellent, excellent.

sa: चक्रवत् तात कार्याणां पर्यायो दृश्यते सदा। कोशस्य निचये यत्नं कुर्वीथा न्यायतः सदा॥
en: You should do your best to fill your treasuries of various kinds by fair means. You should avoid all unlawful means for that purpose.

sa: शूरः क्लेशसहश्चैव हितो भक्तश्च पूरुषः। सर्वे जनपदाश्चैव तव कर्माणि पाण्डव॥
en: Artisans and mechanics, O son of Pandu, living in your provinces, should always do your acts like kine and asses.

sa: भवान् हि परिपाल्यो मे सर्वदैव प्रयत्नतः। साधूनां काक्षितं यस्मात् पितुर्वृद्धस्य पालनम्॥
en: You should be always maintained by me with great care. Maintenance of the father is a duty which the good always covet.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य च धर्मात्मा शिष्यं धर्मपरायणम्। वरेणच्छन्दयामास देवशर्मा महामतिः॥
en: The pious Devasharman receiving his virtuous disciple with a sincere welcome, honoured him with a boon.

sa: इत्येदन्नदानस्य तिलदानस्य चैव ह। भूमिदानस्य च फलं गोदानस्य च कीर्तितम्॥
en: I have thus described to you the merits of making gifts of food, of sesame, of earth, and of kine.

sa: न करिष्यति तल्लोके कश्चिदन्यो नराधिपः॥ यत् कृतं कुरुराजेन मरुत्तस्यानुकुर्वता।
en: No other king will be able to accomplish what the Kuru king did on that occasion like Marutta.

sa: समाश्वास्य ततो राजा विगते कश्मले तदा। ततो मुहूर्तादिव तं ब्राह्मणं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: When that cloudedness of understanding departed and the king became comforted, he spoke after a short time these words to that Brahmana.

sa: तमपास्य च तद्राज्ये तस्य पुत्रं सुवर्चसम्। अभ्यषिञ्चन्त राजेन्द्र मुदिता ह्यभवंस्तदा॥
en: And dethroning him, they, O foremost of kings invested his son Suvarcha with the rights of sovereignty, and experiences joy.

sa: स च शेषो विचरते परया वै मुदा युतः। अन्तर्वसति भोगेन परिरभ्य वसुन्धराम्॥
en: pporting the entire Earth on His head, He lives in the nether regions. He roves through the universe as Shesha, filled with great joy.

sa: न चैनमभिहन्तुं ते शक्नुवन्ति बलक्षये। सम्यग्वृत्तो हि राजा स धर्मनित्यो युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Although his power decreased greatly, yet the enemies could not kill the king, for his power, ( Yudhishthira, was established in virtue.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति चैवेह लोके सम्प्रचरिष्यति। पुण्यकेषु च सर्वेषु परमक्षय्यमेव च॥
en: From this day the gift of these articles in all religious rites shall be established as a custom.

sa: तत्र युद्धानि वृत्तानि यान्यासन् पाण्डवस्य ह। तानि वक्ष्यामि ते वीर विचित्राणि महान्ति च॥
en: In course of the horse's wanderings, O king, many great and wonderful battles were fought between Arjuna and many kings. These I shall describe to you.

sa: के देशाः परिदृष्टास्ते किं च कार्यं करोमि ते। तद् ब्रूहि द्विजमुख्य त्वं त्वं ह्यस्माकं परा गतिः॥
en: What are toe countries which you have passed through? What can I do for you? Do you tell me. You are the foremost of twiceborn ones, and you are our highest refuge.
